raw.description:
Cohort Programs Manager

ABOUT US

UpStart brings bold Jewish ideas to light. For nearly two decades, we've partnered with 250+ organizations and thousands of leaders, connecting impact-driven entrepreneurs to the expertise, community, and capital they need to turn ideas into enduring impact.

UpStart was founded with a sole focus: to accelerate the success of social entrepreneurs fueling a renaissance in Jewish life. Today, we're moving from just program provider to field catalyst — shaping how the entire Jewish innovation ecosystem learns, builds, and grows together. We're actively implementing our FY27–29 Strategic Plan, which puts social entrepreneurs at the center of everything we do and codifies our Jewish Social Innovation & Entrepreneurship (JSIE) Methodology as a shared language for the field.

INCLUSIVE HIRING COMMITMENT

UpStart is an equal opportunity employer, and all individuals are encouraged to apply without regard to race, color, religion, age, disability, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, ancestry, genetic information, medical condition, veteran status, or any other class protected under federal, state, or local laws. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities to apply, even if you don't meet 100% of the qualifications listed.

POSITION SUMMARY

UpStart seeks a Cohort Programs Manager to coordinate UpStart's cohort delivery function. They will serve as the primary project manager across program pathways, responsible for supporting program implementation in alignment with participant needs and required program outcomes. As the first point of contact for our cohort programs, they ensure a high-quality, mission-aligned learning experience for every cohort member.

UpStart designs and delivers cohort-based learning experiences that support Jewish innovators and entrepreneurs at every stage of their journey. UpLift is our flagship multi-month program built on a structured framework for Jewish social innovation. Our custom cohorts offer specialized trainingtailored to the specific needs of funders and institutional partners. Through these learning programs, we create and nurture environments for participants to develop practical skills, build trusted peer relationships, and grow their capacity to lead initiatives that make a lasting difference in Jewish life and the broader world. Cohort sessions span themes including entrepreneurial leadership, adaptive design, and Jewishly informed innovation, with curriculum that continues to evolve in response to participant needs and organizational priorities.

This role reports to the Managing Director, Learning, Community, & Belonging and works in close partnership with our Senior Director, Learning Design & Strategy, Jewish Content Fellow, and UpStart’s Central Operations team. Together, they will align program timelines and virtual/in-person program logistics, ensuring seamless execution from participant registration through completion and evaluation. The Cohort Programs Manager can expect to travel up to 6 times per year for in-person cohort events and team gatherings.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Cohort Delivery & Participant Experience

  • Coordinate end-to-end delivery of virtual and in-person cohort-based learning sessions across multiple program pathways, ensuring physical and virtual spaces are prepared, well-run, and set up for participant success
  • Partner with the Central Operations team (who own recruitment and registration) to help ensure a seamless, high-quality experience from a participant's first touchpoint during recruitment through program completion
  • Provide live virtual session support and ongoing virtual learning support between sessions — e.g., monitoring discussion forums, tracking assignment submissions, and sustaining community engagement
  • Own participant communications across the full program lifecycle, from onboarding through completion and transition to the UpStarter Community, so participants feel informed, guided, and held at every stage
  • Help facilitate a strong cohort culture by fostering trust, connection, and active participation
  • Translate observations into actionable insights for the curriculum design team, surfacing patterns in participant experience, facilitation effectiveness, and content gaps

Program Execution & Operational Management

  • Manage multiple concurrent cohorts and priorities with strong attention to detail and delivery quality, adjusting implementation strategy as needs evolve
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to coordinate program logistics, including virtual sessions and in-person convenings
  • Proactively identify risks and bring forward solutions, exercising sound judgment in dynamic and ambiguous environments
  • Leverage participant feedback and evaluation data to continuously improve program impact and delivery practices

Experience Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a primary, responsive point of contact for cohort participants
  • Serve as organizational resource on participant experience, keeping internal and external stakeholders informed on progress, needs, and outcomes
  • Navigate participant challenges and conflicts with professionalism and strong judgment
  • Partner with Program Team staff and external facilitators to maintain a clear feedback loop between delivery and design, ensuring that live program implementation aligns with intended outcomes
  • Partner with the Senior Director, Learning Design & Strategy and the Central Operations team to align program delivery with overall strategy and execution
  • Coordinate the work of external facilitators and specialists, ensuring alignment with UpStart's delivery standards and participant experience goals
  • Ensure consistency across cohort experiences and facilitators

This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, or responsibilities associated with the position.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of experience with program/project management, event management, and/or participant experience in both virtual and in-person settings
  • Experience supporting cohort-based or group learning programs, with a focus on participant engagement and outcomes
  • Proven ability to own and manage complex operations, including multiple concurrent cohorts or workstreams, with strong attention to detail and quality

  • Comfort supporting virtual learning/LMS environments (e.g., discussion forums, assignment tracking, engagement monitoring)
  • Commitment to leading through a lens of community and belonging
  • Adaptability and agility in the face of change, both organizational and technological
  • Passion for UpStart’s mission and the work of UpStart’s network
  • Commitment to upholding UpStart’s values and Guiding Principles Regarding Client and Program Partnerships.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

UpStart sets salaries using biennial labor market benchmarking, conducted by an independent third-party partner, based on rates of pay at similar Bay Area organizations. Aligned with this practice, and in support of upholding internal equity, we don’t negotiate salaries. The starting annual salary for this role is $70,000.

In addition to a competitive salary, UpStart currently offers the following benefits:

HOW TO APPLY

UpStart is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, UpStart will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided accommodations. If accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Sydney Hirsch, Managing Director, People & Culture at for assistance.

WHAT TO EXPECT

We are committed to a fair and respectful hiring process, and we do our absolute best to respond to every applicant. We prioritize communication and transparency with all candidates, even those who are not moving forward.

raw.description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Senior, Asset Protection Systems Admin supports stores, field teams, supply chain, and fraud functions by administering and improving AP tools and technology. This role deploys, enhances, and maintains exception reporting tools, case management systems, work order systems, and other end-user platforms. Through solution development, partner collaboration, and continuous feedback, the Senior, AP Systems Admin helps strengthen AP operations and collaborates closely with Macy’s Technology, Supply Chain, Fraud, and other business partners.

What You Will Do

  • Administer and support Asset Protection technology platforms, including exception reporting, case management, work order management, and related operational systems.

  • Partner with Asset Protection leadership and business stakeholders to identify system requirements, prioritize enhancements, and develop technology solutions that improve operational performance.

  • Collaborate with Macy's Technology teams on the design, testing, implementation, and maintenance of AP systems and applications.

  • Monitor system performance, user adoption, and operational effectiveness to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for AP technology platforms, providing guidance, troubleshooting, and support to stores, field teams, supply chain partners, and corporate users.

  • Manage system configurations, user access, workflows, and business rules to ensure platforms meet operational and security requirements.

  • Support the deployment of new functionality, upgrades, integrations, and technology enhancements across AP applications.

  • Partner with Fraud, Supply Chain, Stores, and other business teams to understand operational challenges and develop technology-driven solutions.

  • Analyze user feedback, system data, and operational metrics to identify trends and recommend enhancements that improve efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Develop and maintain system documentation, process guides, user procedures, and training materials.

  • Coordinate user acceptance testing and validation efforts for system enhancements and new technology deployments.

  • Support vendor relationships and third-party technology providers to resolve issues and maximize platform performance.

  • Assist in developing reporting and system-based solutions that provide actionable information to operational teams.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, security standards, and data governance requirements across AP systems.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.

  • In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Systems Administration: Experience administering enterprise software platforms, managing configurations, workflows, user access, and system functionality.

Technology Solutions: Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into practical system enhancements and technology solutions.

Platform Management: Knowledge of enterprise applications, software implementations, integrations, and support processes.

Project Coordination: Ability to manage multiple initiatives, coordinate stakeholders, and support technology projects from planning through deployment.

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.

User Support: Commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and technology support to stores, field leaders, and business partners.

Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners, including Technology, Supply Chain, Fraud, Operations, and Asset Protection teams.

Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences.

Testing and Quality Assurance: Experience supporting system testing, validation, and deployment processes to ensure successful implementations.

Process Improvement: Ability to identify inefficiencies, recommend enhancements, and streamline workflows through technology solutions.

Documentation and Training: Skilled at creating training materials, process documentation, and user support resources that drive successful adoption.

Attention to Detail: Strong organizational skills with a focus on system accuracy, data integrity, and execution quality.

Adaptability and Initiative: Self-starter who thrives in a dynamic environment and effectively manages evolving business needs and priorities.

Integrity and Professionalism: Commitment to exemplifying the highest standards of ethics, confidentiality, and professional conduct.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, Asset Protection, Operations, or a related field preferred; equivalent work experience will also be considered.

  • 3+ years of experience supporting enterprise technology systems, applications administration, operations, Asset Protection, fraud prevention, supply chain, or a related discipline.

  • Experience administering software platforms, workflows, user access, and business applications that support operational teams.

  • Experience working with case management systems, reporting platforms, work order systems, fraud tools, exception reporting solutions, or similar enterprise applications preferred.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and experience working with technology support, system administration, or platform management tools.

  • Understanding of software development lifecycle concepts, testing methodologies, and implementation processes preferred.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while supporting both day-to-day operational needs and long-term strategic initiatives.

  • Proven ability to collaborate across multiple departments and influence outcomes through strong partnership and communication skills.

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs, including occasional travel as required.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts

  • Performance-based incentives

  • Annual merit review

  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

  • Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!

This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

raw.excerpt: This environment will suit you if you enjoy building infrastructure from the ground up, solving hard reliability problems and staying close to the systems you operate in production.
raw.description:
This environment will suit you if you enjoy building infrastructure from the ground up, solving hard reliability problems and staying close to the systems you operate in production.

You’ll build and operate the infrastructure behind a new high-volume messaging platform, taking ownership from the Kubernetes cluster and networking layer through observability, deployment and incident response.

The platform processes around 1 million messages every day, supports approximately 175 customers and 120 suppliers, and maintains more than 300 long-lived messaging connections.

This is not a typical stateless web environment. The platform runs long-lived TCP sessions that need stable network endpoints and predictable behaviour during deployments, failures and traffic spikes.

You’ll help build the platform across two infrastructure sites and stay with it through production readiness, migration, hypercare and steady-state operation.

Rate: 150–190 PLN + VAT (B2B) per hour.

Location: Fully remote (Poland) 🌎 or Łódź (Poland)

Your everyday challenges:

  • Use AI-assisted engineering where it improves delivery - including infrastructure tooling, automation, documentation and runbooks.

  • Build and operate Kubernetes infrastructure across two sites using infrastructure-as-code and automated delivery.

  • Design deployment mechanisms that allow long-lived connections to drain gracefullyinstead of being dropped during releases.

  • Take ownership of platform networking, including stable ingress and egress IPs, Layer 4 load balancing, TLS and connectivity coordinated with an external infrastructure provider.

  • Build and operate the observability stack: metrics, logs, dashboards and alerting that provide useful signal rather than noise.

  • Design monitoring around real production behaviour, including visibility into individual connections and failure modes.

  • Own certificate lifecycle, secrets management and platform access control.

  • Operate PostgreSQL in a highly available environment, including replication, failover, backups and verified restores.

  • Design and exercise backup and disaster-recovery procedures across two sites.

  • Work closely with engineers and QA on performance and production-scale load testing, investigating what fails first and why.

  • Support the platform during migration and production cutovers.

  • Take part in production incident response and from the steady-state phase, a 24×7 on-call rotation.

What are we looking for?

  • Experience with telecom, carrier, messaging or other environments built around persistent network connections.

  • Knowledge of SMPP, SIP, SS7 or similar telecom protocols.

  • Strong production experience operating Kubernetes on self-managed, on-premise or similarly infrastructure-heavy environments - not only managed cloud services.

  • Experience with stateful, long-lived TCP workloads on Kubernetes, including connection draining, stable ingress/egress, Layer 4 load balancing and deployment behaviour.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals. You are comfortable diagnosing problems involving routing, NAT, firewalls, MTU, TLS or packet-level behaviour.

  • Practical troubleshooting experience with tools such as tcpdump and production network diagnostics.

  • Experience designing monitoring and alerting, not only maintaining dashboards somebody else created. You understand what deserves to wake a human up, and what does not.

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD experience for containerised systems.

  • Practical PostgreSQL operations experience, including replication, failover, backup and importantly - verified restore.

  • Ability to work directly with engineers from external infrastructure and network providers.

  • Professional English.

  • Real production on-call and incident-response experience.

What will strengthen your candidacy?

  • Experience configuring or troubleshooting IPsec connectivity with external parties.

  • Experience designing or operating multi-site active-active or active-passive environments.

  • Hands-on disaster-recovery exercises rather than DR plans that existed only on paper.

  • Performance engineering experience, including Linux kernel or network tuning for high connection counts.

  • Security hardening experience, including CIS-style benchmarks, vulnerability management or software supply-chain practices.

  • Experience being the first SRE or Platform Engineer on a system and defining how it should be operated.

Why join us?

  • Build it and run it: you won’t inherit an infrastructure somebody else designed or throw your work over the wall after launch. You’ll help build the platform and remain close to it in production.

  • A genuinely difficult reliability problem: long-lived protocol traffic, stateful connections, two-site infrastructure and production traffic at telecom scale.

  • Influence architecture from day one: deployment, observability and operability are design constraints here, not tasks postponed until after development.

  • Greenfield infrastructure: you’ll have real influence over how the Kubernetes platform, delivery pipelines, monitoring and operational practices are created.

  • Small senior team: short decision paths and direct collaboration with engineers and the solution architect.

  • Production ownership: you’ll follow the system through build, migration, hypercare and steady-state operation instead of disappearing after implementation.

  • Modern engineering environment: automation and AI-assisted tooling are used where they genuinely improve engineering and operational work.

Sounds like a fit? Let’s talk! 🚀

AECOM Construction Management is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer, Internal Data Products to turn everyday business challenges into applications that help construction teams work more effectively.

As part of our growing Data & AI Enablement team, you’ll work directly with construction professionals and business leaders to understand their workflows, build prototypes, and deliver useful solutions. Projects may include replacing spreadsheet processes, building staffing and resource planning applications, and improving visibility into project operations.

This role combines business discovery with hands-on software development. You’ll use AI-assisted development to move quickly, partner closely with our data platform owner, and take solutions from initial conversations through deployment and improvement. You’ll have direct access to users, ownership of meaningful work, and the opportunity to shape tools used across projects and regions.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from any location within the US where AECOM has an office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work directly with business leaders and construction teams to understand workflows, clarify ambiguous needs, and define requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Design and build internal applications, automations, and data products, working across user interfaces, application logic, databases, and APIs as needed.
  • Rapidly prototype and validate solutions with users, choosing practical approaches across AI-assisted coding, traditional development, low-code tools, and existing technology.
  • Partner with Data & Integration Engineering to connect applications to governed enterprise and project data, using consistent data definitions and established technical standards.
  • Own delivery from discovery through deployment, including testing, documentation, stakeholder communication, and coordination of technical dependencies and blockers.
  • Measure adoption and business impact, improve solutions based on feedback, and turn successful tools into reusable capabilities across teams, projects, and regions.

Minimum Qualifications:

Forward Deployed Engineer, Internal Data Products, Level III

  • Bachelor’s degree plus at least four (4) years of relevant software engineering experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

OR

Forward Deployed Engineer, Internal Data Products, Level IV

AND

  • Experience working directly with nontechnical stakeholders to understand business needs, translate them into technical requirements, and communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, or Java, along with practical experience using SQL, relational databases, and APIs to build integrated applications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience replacing spreadsheet-based processes with internal applications or automations for nontechnical users.
  • Experience in a startup or small team requiring rapid prototyping, broad ownership, and close collaboration with users.
  • Experience extending a prototype or team-level application into a reliable solution used across multiple teams, projects, or locations.
  • Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

raw.description:
At MyFitnessPal, we believe good health starts with what you eat. We provide tools, resources and support to enable users to reach their health goals.

We are looking for a Software Engineer III - Site Reliability to join the MyFitnessPal PEAS team. As a member of the PEAS team, you'll have the opportunity to positively impact MyFitnessPal users through your expertise in the reliability and delivery systems that keep the MyFitnessPal ecosystem fast, available, and safe to change. In addition to technical expertise, you'll find that your teammates value collaboration, mentorship, and inclusive environments.

About the team:

The Productivity Engineering: Automation & Self-Service (PEAS) team is responsible for the automation, CI/CD, and self-service platforms that product teams rely on to build, test, and ship features quickly and safely.

The PEAS team is part of the Technology Operations (TechOps) organization, which includes IT, Infrastructure, Security, Reliability, and DevOps/DevEx disciplines. TechOps seeks to enable MyFitnessPal to "ship with confidence" by delivering a secure, reliable, and low-friction runway to build and operate software at scale.

Essential Duties:

As a Software Engineer III on the PEAS team, you will own reliability across our production services and maintain security in the software delivery pipeline. You'll define how we measure and defend reliability, lead us through incidents, and make our CI/CD pipelines both faster and harder to compromise. You will play a key role in delivering an outstanding experience to MyFitnessPal users.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own and evolve our SLI/SLO and error-budget frameworks, and use them to influence prioritization and product decisions
  • Lead incident response, drive postmortems, and turn findings into systemic fixes rather than one-off patches
  • Build and maintain observability across metrics, logs, and traces (Datadog), improving signal and reducing alert fatigue
  • Design and operate resilient, scalable infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  • Manage production Kubernetes and container workloads, including capacity planning and cloud-cost optimization
  • Own CI/CD pipelines and safe deployment strategies (canary, progressive rollout, fast rollback)
  • Own the security controls that live inside the delivery pipeline — integrating and tuning SAST, DAST, and SCA scanning (for example, in GitHub Actions) so issues surface while code is still in review
  • Implement and maintain policy-as-code (for example, OPA/Rego, Kyverno, or Conftest) to block unsafe infrastructure and Kubernetes changes at admission time
  • Drive vulnerability triage and remediation SLAs for pipeline- and infrastructure-level findings, prioritizing by real risk
  • Partner with our Security Engineer and the broader Security & Reliability disciplines — you own security in the pipeline and collaborate on the rest, rather than duplicating that function
  • Participate in and improve the on-call rotation; build the runbooks and automation that make on-call sustainable
  • Coach team members and engineers across the org on reliability patterns and operational best practices

Qualifications to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years in site reliability, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with clear senior-level ownership of production systems
  • Strong programming skills for automation and tooling (Go, Python, Typescript or similar) — you have experience building software or custom tooling, not just scripts
  • Deep, hands-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS is a plus), Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform is a plus)
  • Proven track record leading incident response and building SLO-driven reliability practices.
  • Working fluency with observability tooling (Datadog is a plus)
  • Practical experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines — SAST/DAST/SCA tooling, dependency scanning, or policy-as-code
  • Strong understanding of cloud security fundamentals (identity/IAM, least-privilege patterns, policy/guardrails, secrets management)
  • The judgment and communication skills to raise a security or reliability finding with a senior engineer and land it as a shared problem to solve, not a fight to win
  • Experience with policy-as-code frameworks (especially Kyverno, but tools like OPA/Rego or Conftest are also relevant) enforced at admission time is a plus
  • Exposure to regulated or compliance-driven environments (SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA) is a plus
  • Chaos engineering or game-day experience is a plus
  • Experience supporting B2C/mobile backend environments with high traffic, rapid iteration, and strong reliability needs is a plus

Values you’ll model

  • Be Kind and Care — build with empathy; assume positive intent; support teammates and members.
  • Live Good Health — champion healthy habits and balance in how we work and what we ship.
  • Be Data-Inspired — ground decisions in research and data; measure what matters.
  • Champion Change — lean into ambiguity; iterate, learn, and improve continuously.
  • Leave it Better than You Found It — raise quality, clarify systems, and document as you go.
  • Make It Happen — bias to action; deliver impact with craft and accountability.

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at MyFitnessPal ranges from $120,000 - $165,000. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, MyFitnessPal offers a wide range of comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, parental planning, mental health benefits, annual performance bonus, a 401(k) plan and match, responsible time off, monthly wellness and technology allowances, and others.

Exciting Full-Time Employee Benefits, Perks and Culture

Face-to-Face Connections: We value personal connections. Enjoy opportunities to meet and connect with your team members in person to help forge meaningful relationships that extend beyond the virtual realm. Teams meet as often as needed and all of MyFitnessPal gathers annually.

We understand the complexities of starting or expanding a family, which is why we provide best-in-class comprehensive assistance for fertility-related matters.

Wellness Comes First: Live Good Health is one of our core values. Receive a monthly Wellness Allowance, empowering you to focus on your physical and mental well-being by choosing from a range of wellness initiatives, including dedicated mental health days.

raw.title: Senior Data Scientist, Credit
raw.excerpt: Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success.
raw.description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to build and improve the machine learning models behind Mission Lane's credit decisions.

The impact you'll make:

Behind every “yes” from Mission Lane is a model that had to see past a credit score to the story behind it, the kind of story that doesn't fit neatly into three digits. You'll build and sharpen the models that read that signal right: accurate enough to trust, fair enough to stand behind, and sound enough to move our customers forward.

A lot of our applicants don't have years of clean credit history to lean on, so the standard score alone doesn't get you very far. That means you'll get to dig into the interesting work of figuring out what else predicts repayment.

Mission Lane is still young, but we’ve landed in an exciting, stable stretch of maturation, and you'll learn and grow right along with us.

As Senior Data Scientist you will:

  • Design, build, and deploy supervised learning models that power Mission Lane's credit decisions, from first experiment through production
  • Partner with credit risk and portfolio teams to translate open business questions into modeling problems, and communicate the trade-offs between them
  • Monitor models already in production, catching drift and validating performance so they keep doing what they were built to do
  • Apply strong software engineering practices to your modeling work, including test-driven development, code review, and refactoring
  • Explore new data sources and modeling approaches using Mission Lane's Python data stack.

Our core tech stack includes:

Python and the Python data stack (numpy, polars, scikit-learn), LightGBM, DVC, Kubernetes, Airflow, Google Cloud, and Chalk, our feature store.

You'll thrive in this role if:

  • You're motivated by practical solutions, and curiosity is part of how you work every day.
  • You haven't necessarily worked in credit or lending before, but you're excited to learn a domain where regulations and long-horizon predictions matter.
  • You're comfortable with the full lifecycle of a model, including the less glamorous parts like data cleanup, monitoring, and validation.
  • You work well with people outside data science and can explain a modeling decision in plain language.

Minimum qualifications:

raw.excerpt: ABOUT US Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower.
raw.description:
ABOUT US

Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower. Designed by world leaders in metabolic health, our program combines clinical research, personalized coaching, and lifestyle intervention to deliver lasting weight loss and improved metabolic outcomes. With obesity as America’s largest chronic condition, impacting 175mm adults in a $600B market, we’re closing the care gap by offering the first value-based model in obesity treatment.

Since launching Direct-to-Consumer in 2020, we’ve expanded into Enterprise channels to improve access, and our app-based experience supports members with coaching, tailored education, daily tracking, and community engagement across the four pillars of metabolic health: food, sleep, exercise, and emotional wellbeing.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Senior Customer Success Manager will own the relationship between Calibrate and our enterprise client partners, serving as a trusted strategic advisor to client decision makers. This role will lead strategic account planning and execution, identify opportunities for growth and expansion, and educate clients on how to maximize the value they receive from Calibrate.

Our goal is to ensure clients are successful, engaged, and enthusiastic advocates for Calibrate, helping them effectively communicate and promote the value of our programs to their employees and dependents. As a key member of the Client Success team, you will also bring valuable customer insights back to the organization to inform our product, service, and development roadmap.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As a primary point of contact and face of Calibrate to our clients, you will be responsible for:

  • Build and strengthen strategic relationships with enterprise client decision makers, and other key stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor and partner.
  • Drive customer satisfaction, engagement, enrollment, and program value across a portfolio of enterprise clients by developing thoughtful, outcome focused strategies.
  • Own strategic account plans and growth strategies, identifying opportunities to expand partnerships, deepen engagement, and drive long term client value.
  • Partner with clients on a day to day basis to address and resolve client and/or member issues promptly and effectively.
  • Lead client communications and business reviews, providing timely updates, performance reporting, service level metrics, and actionable insights through effective meetings and compelling quarterly business reviews.
  • Understand and anticipate client needs, leveraging cross functional internal resources to address challenges and opportunities while driving retention, expansion, and customer advocacy.
  • Translate customer feedback into actionable insights, partnering with internal teams to inform Calibrate’s priorities, product development, and customer experience.
  • Develop and share best practices that elevate the effectiveness of the Client Success team and strengthen our overall approach to enterprise client management.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience supporting clients and managing an account portfolio, preferably in the healthcare space.
  • Prior commercial experience managing health and wellness benefits to employers.
  • An expert at communicating and presenting data to tell meaningful and actionable stories that result in value recognition and retention.
  • Ability to effectively communicate client feedback and sentiment to internal stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with extreme attention to detail.
  • Comfort building strong interpersonal relationships with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience in a fast paced environment and the ability to successfully operate in ambiguity with a bias for action.
  • Passionate about innovation in digital health.

BENEFITS

At Calibrate, we’re committed to putting our team members in control of their health. In 2026, we are proudly offering the following benefits:

  • Enjoy a generous paid time off policy, including multiple paid company holidays, wellness days, and floating holidays to support your work-life blend.
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefit options to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Calibrate-funded disability and basic life insurance, ensuring peace of mind during unforeseen events.
  • Access to several wellness programs, including a complimentary Headspace membership, and therapy on your schedule with Headspace Care.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Principal to receive counseling on a wide range of topics.
  • Remote-first ways of working, with the flexibility to work from any state.
  • Competitive paid parental leave program to support new parents.

OUR VALUES

Members First. Always.

Every decision starts with one question - Will this improve the health and the experience of the people we serve?

Outcomes That Matter.

We measure success through sustained weight loss and meaningful improvements in cardiometabolic health.

Integrated Care Wins.

Obesity care requires more than medication alone. We combine clinical care, behavior change, and technology into one coordinated care model.

Relentless Improvement.

We continuously learn from outcomes, data, and our experience to refine our care model and raise the standard of obesity treatment.

Great Partners.

We strive to be easy to work with and trusted by patients, employers, clinicians, partners, and our fellow Calibraters.

Calibrate is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all team members. To achieve our mission of changing the way the world treats weight, we are building an environment where every Calibrater can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do the best work of their careers. We value diversity and recruit, hire, and promote individuals solely based on talent, qualifications, competence, and merit. We evaluate candidates without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other protected characteristics as required by law and as a matter of our company values.

About Cyber CentaursCyber Centaurs is a digital forensics and incident response firm helping organizations investigate cyber incidents, preserve and analyze digital evidence, respond to data breaches, and make informed decisions based on defensible technical findings.

raw.title: Client Engagement Specialist
raw.excerpt: This is a remote position. About Cyber CentaursCyber Centaurs is a digital forensics and incident response firm helping organizations investigate cyber incidents, preserve and analyze digital evidence, respond to data breaches, and make informed decisions based on defensible technical findings.
raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About Cyber Centaurs

Cyber Centaurs is a digital forensics and incident response firm helping organizations investigate cyber incidents, preserve and analyze digital evidence, respond to data breaches, and make informed decisions based on defensible technical findings. Our work includes business email compromise, ransomware, insider threats, employee data theft, cloud investigations, digital forensics, penetration testing, and expert witness matters.

We serve organizations, law firms, executives, IT leaders, and other professionals across the United States.

The Opportunity

Cyber Centaurs is seeking a Client Engagement Specialist to support our growing volume of inbound client inquiries and help ensure prospective and existing clients receive a fast, professional, and organized response.

This is not a traditional administrative or call-center position.

The Client Engagement Specialist will often be the first person a prospective client speaks with when contacting Cyber Centaurs about an urgent cybersecurity incident, suspected employee misconduct, digital forensic matter, or other sensitive situation. The ideal candidate is highly organized, confident speaking with executives and professionals, comfortable handling urgent situations, and commercially minded. The role will initially focus on client intake, lead qualification, scheduling, follow-up, CRM management, and sales support. Over time, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to develop deeper knowledge of Cyber Centaurs’ services and progress toward conducting client discovery calls and independently managing standard client engagements.

Key Responsibilities

Client Intake & Initial Response
  • Respond promptly and professionally to inbound telephone calls, website inquiries, email inquiries, and other prospective client communications.
  • Gather initial information about cybersecurity incidents, digital forensic matters, and client needs.
  • Identify urgency, basic scope, relevant stakeholders, and immediate next steps.
  • Ensure urgent matters are escalated appropriately.
  • Maintain a calm and professional client experience during high-pressure situations.
  • Coordinate initial meetings with the Client Engagement Manager or other appropriate team members.

Lead Qualification
  • Conduct initial qualification of inbound opportunities.
  • Determine whether inquiries align with Cyber Centaurs’ services, target clients, and engagement requirements.
  • Identify key details needed before a consultation or proposal can be prepared.
  • Help protect senior sales and technical staff from unqualified or inappropriate inquiries.
  • Maintain accurate lead status and qualification information within the CRM.

Scheduling & Client Coordination
  • Manage and coordinate consultation scheduling.
  • Ensure clients receive appropriate intake forms, instructions, meeting links, and pre-engagement information.
  • Follow up on missing information required for consultations or proposals.
  • Coordinate communications between prospective clients, the Client Engagement Manager, and the technical team.
  • Help ensure smooth handoffs from sales into active investigations and engagements.

Sales & Proposal Support
  • Assist with preparation and coordination of proposals, engagement documentation, and client follow-up.
  • Track outstanding proposals, agreements, deposits, and next steps.
  • Follow up with prospective clients when appropriate.
  • Support the Client Engagement Manager in maintaining an organized and responsive sales pipeline.
  • Help ensure opportunities do not stall due to missed follow-up or administrative delays.

CRM & Pipeline Management
  • Maintain accurate and complete CRM records.
  • Document calls, communications, lead status, matter details, and next actions.
  • Monitor open opportunities and required follow-up activities.
  • Help maintain pipeline accuracy and visibility.
  • Identify opportunities where automation or process improvements could improve responsiveness.

Career Development

This position is designed with a growth path. As the Client Engagement Specialist develops a strong understanding of Cyber Centaurs’ services, pricing, investigative processes, and client needs, responsibilities may expand to include:

  • Conducting initial discovery calls independently.
  • Assisting clients in determining the appropriate forensic or incident response service.
  • Scoping standard engagements.
  • Presenting standard service options and pricing.
  • Managing selected opportunities through proposal and close.
  • Developing client and referral relationships.
  • Progressing toward a future Client Engagement Manager role.

Advancement will be based on demonstrated performance, judgment, service knowledge, communication ability, and commercial capability.


Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in a client-facing, sales-support, account coordination, professional services, customer service, intake, or similar role.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up discipline.
  • Comfortable speaking with business owners, executives, attorneys, IT professionals, and other senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to remain professional and composed when clients are dealing with urgent or stressful situations.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple active conversations, appointments, and follow-up activities.
  • Comfortable working with CRM systems and modern business software.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong judgment regarding when an issue should be escalated.

Preferred
  • Experience in cybersecurity, IT services, legal services, digital forensics, insurance, consulting, managed services, or another professional services environment.
  • Experience supporting a sales or business development team.
  • Experience qualifying inbound leads.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts such as ransomware, business email compromise, Microsoft 365 compromise, data breaches, insider threats, or digital forensics.
  • Experience working with attorneys, executives, or technical professionals.
  • Experience with Zoho CRM or a comparable CRM platform.
  • Experience working in a fast-growing small or mid-sized business.
  • Direct digital forensics or cybersecurity experience is helpful but is not required. Cyber Centaurs will provide training on our services, common investigation types, engagement processes, and client qualification procedures.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Client Engagement Specialist will help Cyber Centaurs achieve:

  • Fast response to inbound client inquiries.
  • Fewer missed or delayed client communications.
  • Consistent qualification of prospective engagements.
  • Accurate and organized CRM records.
  • Improved scheduling and follow-up.
  • Faster movement from inquiry to consultation, proposal, and engagement.
  • A strong client experience from the first interaction.
  • Increased capacity for the Client Engagement Manager to focus on consultations, proposals, closing opportunities, and strategic client relationships.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You may be a strong fit for this role if you are someone who:

  • Enjoys interacting with clients and helping solve problems.
  • Naturally follows up and keeps matters moving.
  • Communicates confidently without being overly aggressive.
  • Can recognize when something is urgent.
  • Is comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly.
  • Enjoys learning complex services and becoming more knowledgeable over time.
  • Wants to grow into a larger client engagement or sales responsibility.
  • Understands that responsiveness and organization directly influence whether a prospective client chooses to engage a firm.

Work Environment

This is a remote position.

Because Cyber Centaurs serves clients nationwide and many matters require rapid response, candidates located in the Mountain or Pacific Time Zone are strongly preferred. This helps extend client coverage later into the Eastern Time Zone business day.

The position requires reliable internet connectivity, a professional remote work environment, and the ability to communicate by phone, video conference, email, and collaboration platforms throughout the workday.


Benefits

Compensation & Benefits
  • Base Salary: $65,000–$75,000, depending on experience and qualifications
  • Performance-based incentive compensation
  • Paid time off
  • Paid holidays
  • Remote work environment
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Training in digital forensics, incident response, cybersecurity services, and client engagement
  • Career advancement opportunities within a growing cybersecurity services firm

Why Join Cyber Centaurs

Cyber Centaurs is growing rapidly and investing in both its technical capabilities and client engagement infrastructure.

This position offers the opportunity to become an important part of the firm’s growth while gaining exposure to real-world cybersecurity incidents, digital forensic investigations, legal matters, and complex client engagements.

For someone who combines strong communication, organization, judgment, and commercial instincts, this role can develop into a broader client engagement and business development career within the company.

Job Description

Benzinga is seeking an Analytics Engineering Intern to join our Data Science team for a 12-week, part-time, remote internship. This is an analytics and business-intelligence-focused role centered on data modeling, dashboards, and data interpretation — not a software engineering role. You will build SQL data models within our data pipeline framework and design meaningful dashboards, assess data quality, and translate raw data into insights stakeholders can act on.

Key Responsibilities

  • Write SQL that transforms raw data into structured datasets as part of a data pipeline and turn it into something a dashboard can use.
  • Support existing reporting and develop new reporting and dashboard work.
  • Build a deliverable project: design and build SQL data models connecting to a source dataset, build a Looker Studio dashboard, validate with a stakeholder, and present both the dashboard and the findings uncovered along the way.
  • Conduct data quality checks and learn to identify and troubleshoot common data issues.
  • Collaborate with a stakeholder to ensure a dashboard deliverable actually answers the business question being asked, not just the question as first stated.
  • Present findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Use AI coding assistants as a tool to accelerate work, with the expectation that all code is understood, verified, and can be explained rather than accepted at face value.

Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Economics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Basic SQL proficiency: comfortable with SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, and simple aggregations
  • Basic familiarity with version control concepts, such as using Git.

Preferred Experience

  • Exposure to a BI/visualization tool (Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Familiarity with GitLab or GitHub merge request/pull request workflow.
  • Exposure to web application, marketing, or financial/media data.
  • Prior experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) for coursework or personal projects.
Salary: $20 – $25 / hour

raw.description:
Cohort Programs Manager

ABOUT US

UpStart brings bold Jewish ideas to light. For nearly two decades, we've partnered with 250+ organizations and thousands of leaders, connecting impact-driven entrepreneurs to the expertise, community, and capital they need to turn ideas into enduring impact.

UpStart was founded with a sole focus: to accelerate the success of social entrepreneurs fueling a renaissance in Jewish life. Today, we're moving from just program provider to field catalyst — shaping how the entire Jewish innovation ecosystem learns, builds, and grows together. We're actively implementing our FY27–29 Strategic Plan, which puts social entrepreneurs at the center of everything we do and codifies our Jewish Social Innovation & Entrepreneurship (JSIE) Methodology as a shared language for the field.

INCLUSIVE HIRING COMMITMENT

UpStart is an equal opportunity employer, and all individuals are encouraged to apply without regard to race, color, religion, age, disability, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, ancestry, genetic information, medical condition, veteran status, or any other class protected under federal, state, or local laws. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities to apply, even if you don't meet 100% of the qualifications listed.

POSITION SUMMARY

UpStart seeks a Cohort Programs Manager to coordinate UpStart's cohort delivery function. They will serve as the primary project manager across program pathways, responsible for supporting program implementation in alignment with participant needs and required program outcomes. As the first point of contact for our cohort programs, they ensure a high-quality, mission-aligned learning experience for every cohort member.

UpStart designs and delivers cohort-based learning experiences that support Jewish innovators and entrepreneurs at every stage of their journey. UpLift is our flagship multi-month program built on a structured framework for Jewish social innovation. Our custom cohorts offer specialized trainingtailored to the specific needs of funders and institutional partners. Through these learning programs, we create and nurture environments for participants to develop practical skills, build trusted peer relationships, and grow their capacity to lead initiatives that make a lasting difference in Jewish life and the broader world. Cohort sessions span themes including entrepreneurial leadership, adaptive design, and Jewishly informed innovation, with curriculum that continues to evolve in response to participant needs and organizational priorities.

This role reports to the Managing Director, Learning, Community, & Belonging and works in close partnership with our Senior Director, Learning Design & Strategy, Jewish Content Fellow, and UpStart’s Central Operations team. Together, they will align program timelines and virtual/in-person program logistics, ensuring seamless execution from participant registration through completion and evaluation. The Cohort Programs Manager can expect to travel up to 6 times per year for in-person cohort events and team gatherings.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Cohort Delivery & Participant Experience

  • Coordinate end-to-end delivery of virtual and in-person cohort-based learning sessions across multiple program pathways, ensuring physical and virtual spaces are prepared, well-run, and set up for participant success
  • Partner with the Central Operations team (who own recruitment and registration) to help ensure a seamless, high-quality experience from a participant's first touchpoint during recruitment through program completion
  • Provide live virtual session support and ongoing virtual learning support between sessions — e.g., monitoring discussion forums, tracking assignment submissions, and sustaining community engagement
  • Own participant communications across the full program lifecycle, from onboarding through completion and transition to the UpStarter Community, so participants feel informed, guided, and held at every stage
  • Help facilitate a strong cohort culture by fostering trust, connection, and active participation
  • Translate observations into actionable insights for the curriculum design team, surfacing patterns in participant experience, facilitation effectiveness, and content gaps

Program Execution & Operational Management

  • Manage multiple concurrent cohorts and priorities with strong attention to detail and delivery quality, adjusting implementation strategy as needs evolve
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to coordinate program logistics, including virtual sessions and in-person convenings
  • Proactively identify risks and bring forward solutions, exercising sound judgment in dynamic and ambiguous environments
  • Leverage participant feedback and evaluation data to continuously improve program impact and delivery practices

Experience Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a primary, responsive point of contact for cohort participants
  • Serve as organizational resource on participant experience, keeping internal and external stakeholders informed on progress, needs, and outcomes
  • Navigate participant challenges and conflicts with professionalism and strong judgment
  • Partner with Program Team staff and external facilitators to maintain a clear feedback loop between delivery and design, ensuring that live program implementation aligns with intended outcomes
  • Partner with the Senior Director, Learning Design & Strategy and the Central Operations team to align program delivery with overall strategy and execution
  • Coordinate the work of external facilitators and specialists, ensuring alignment with UpStart's delivery standards and participant experience goals
  • Ensure consistency across cohort experiences and facilitators

This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, or responsibilities associated with the position.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of experience with program/project management, event management, and/or participant experience in both virtual and in-person settings
  • Experience supporting cohort-based or group learning programs, with a focus on participant engagement and outcomes
  • Proven ability to own and manage complex operations, including multiple concurrent cohorts or workstreams, with strong attention to detail and quality
  • Experience translating curriculum or program plans into high-quality, well-executed participant experiences
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with operations, design, and/or external partners
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and navigate participant needs or challenges
  • Familiarity with leading practices as it relates to designing accessible, inclusive events for adult learners preferred, including coordinating catering, supplies, accommodations, etc.
  • Sound judgment and problem-solving skills in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
  • Experience coordinating the work of facilitators or program staff
  • Exposure to AI-powered tools or interest in deploying them
  • Ability to synthesize participant feedback and evaluation data to drive continuous improvement in program delivery
  • Commitment to equity, inclusion, and creating meaningful learning environments for diverse participants
  • Comfort with change, iteration, and working in a dynamic, evolving program model
  • Comfort supporting virtual learning/LMS environments (e.g., discussion forums, assignment tracking, engagement monitoring)
  • Commitment to leading through a lens of community and belonging
  • Adaptability and agility in the face of change, both organizational and technological
  • Passion for UpStart’s mission and the work of UpStart’s network
  • Commitment to upholding UpStart’s values and Guiding Principles Regarding Client and Program Partnerships.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

UpStart sets salaries using biennial labor market benchmarking, conducted by an independent third-party partner, based on rates of pay at similar Bay Area organizations. Aligned with this practice, and in support of upholding internal equity, we don’t negotiate salaries. The starting annual salary for this role is $70,000.

In addition to a competitive salary, UpStart currently offers the following benefits:

  • A comprehensive benefits package, including 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance.
  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave with no waiting period.
  • 100% employer-funded Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) for medical-related travel, up to $1,950 per year.
  • FSA and Commuter Benefits accounts.
  • Employer-sponsored 401K with employer match.
  • Flexible discretionary paid time off.
  • Annual $1,500 professional development stipend.
  • One-time $300 office setup stipend and provided Mac.
  • Monthly $50 cell phone stipend.
  • 3:00pm local close-of-business on Fridays.
  • Days off for all work-prohibitive Jewish holidays, in addition to secular US holidays.
  • A one-month (30 days) paid sabbatical per every five years of employment.
  • Occasional travel for meetings, conferences, and other business-related activities.
  • A great workplace culture! Check out our culture deck here.

HOW TO APPLY

Use the fields below to submit your resume and a thoughtful, one-page cover letter to our hiring team.

UpStart is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, UpStart will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided accommodations. If accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Sydney Hirsch, Managing Director, People & Culture at for assistance.

WHAT TO EXPECT

We are committed to a fair and respectful hiring process, and we do our absolute best to respond to every applicant. We prioritize communication and transparency with all candidates, even those who are not moving forward.

Here’s an overview of our hiring process*:

  • Step 1: Apply with your resume and cover letter!
  • Step 2: Phone screen with an UpStart recruiter.
  • Step 3: Video interview with the hiring manager.
  • Step 4: A video interview with a panel of UpStart employees.
  • Step 5: We’ll check your references to learn about your past experience.
  • Step 6: Get an offer letter, sign it, and start your professional journey with UpStart!

*Note: Some of our hiring processes may vary, and not all candidates will advance to each step.

raw.description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Senior, Asset Protection Systems Admin supports stores, field teams, supply chain, and fraud functions by administering and improving AP tools and technology. This role deploys, enhances, and maintains exception reporting tools, case management systems, work order systems, and other end-user platforms. Through solution development, partner collaboration, and continuous feedback, the Senior, AP Systems Admin helps strengthen AP operations and collaborates closely with Macy’s Technology, Supply Chain, Fraud, and other business partners.

What You Will Do

  • Administer and support Asset Protection technology platforms, including exception reporting, case management, work order management, and related operational systems.

  • Partner with Asset Protection leadership and business stakeholders to identify system requirements, prioritize enhancements, and develop technology solutions that improve operational performance.

  • Collaborate with Macy's Technology teams on the design, testing, implementation, and maintenance of AP systems and applications.

  • Monitor system performance, user adoption, and operational effectiveness to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for AP technology platforms, providing guidance, troubleshooting, and support to stores, field teams, supply chain partners, and corporate users.

  • Manage system configurations, user access, workflows, and business rules to ensure platforms meet operational and security requirements.

  • Support the deployment of new functionality, upgrades, integrations, and technology enhancements across AP applications.

  • Partner with Fraud, Supply Chain, Stores, and other business teams to understand operational challenges and develop technology-driven solutions.

  • Analyze user feedback, system data, and operational metrics to identify trends and recommend enhancements that improve efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Develop and maintain system documentation, process guides, user procedures, and training materials.

  • Coordinate user acceptance testing and validation efforts for system enhancements and new technology deployments.

  • Support vendor relationships and third-party technology providers to resolve issues and maximize platform performance.

  • Assist in developing reporting and system-based solutions that provide actionable information to operational teams.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, security standards, and data governance requirements across AP systems.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.

  • In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Systems Administration: Experience administering enterprise software platforms, managing configurations, workflows, user access, and system functionality.

Technology Solutions: Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into practical system enhancements and technology solutions.

Platform Management: Knowledge of enterprise applications, software implementations, integrations, and support processes.

Project Coordination: Ability to manage multiple initiatives, coordinate stakeholders, and support technology projects from planning through deployment.

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.

User Support: Commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and technology support to stores, field leaders, and business partners.

Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners, including Technology, Supply Chain, Fraud, Operations, and Asset Protection teams.

Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences.

Testing and Quality Assurance: Experience supporting system testing, validation, and deployment processes to ensure successful implementations.

Process Improvement: Ability to identify inefficiencies, recommend enhancements, and streamline workflows through technology solutions.

Documentation and Training: Skilled at creating training materials, process documentation, and user support resources that drive successful adoption.

Attention to Detail: Strong organizational skills with a focus on system accuracy, data integrity, and execution quality.

Adaptability and Initiative: Self-starter who thrives in a dynamic environment and effectively manages evolving business needs and priorities.

Integrity and Professionalism: Commitment to exemplifying the highest standards of ethics, confidentiality, and professional conduct.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, Asset Protection, Operations, or a related field preferred; equivalent work experience will also be considered.

  • 3+ years of experience supporting enterprise technology systems, applications administration, operations, Asset Protection, fraud prevention, supply chain, or a related discipline.

  • Experience administering software platforms, workflows, user access, and business applications that support operational teams.

  • Experience working with case management systems, reporting platforms, work order systems, fraud tools, exception reporting solutions, or similar enterprise applications preferred.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and experience working with technology support, system administration, or platform management tools.

  • Understanding of software development lifecycle concepts, testing methodologies, and implementation processes preferred.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while supporting both day-to-day operational needs and long-term strategic initiatives.

  • Proven ability to collaborate across multiple departments and influence outcomes through strong partnership and communication skills.

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs, including occasional travel as required.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts

  • Performance-based incentives

  • Annual merit review

  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

  • Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!

This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

raw.title: Senior SRE / DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes / A2P Messaging)
raw.excerpt: This environment will suit you if you enjoy building infrastructure from the ground up, solving hard reliability problems and staying close to the systems you operate in production.
raw.description:
This environment will suit you if you enjoy building infrastructure from the ground up, solving hard reliability problems and staying close to the systems you operate in production.

You’ll build and operate the infrastructure behind a new high-volume messaging platform, taking ownership from the Kubernetes cluster and networking layer through observability, deployment and incident response.

The platform processes around 1 million messages every day, supports approximately 175 customers and 120 suppliers, and maintains more than 300 long-lived messaging connections.

This is not a typical stateless web environment. The platform runs long-lived TCP sessions that need stable network endpoints and predictable behaviour during deployments, failures and traffic spikes.

You’ll help build the platform across two infrastructure sites and stay with it through production readiness, migration, hypercare and steady-state operation.

Rate: 150–190 PLN + VAT (B2B) per hour.

Location: Fully remote (Poland) 🌎 or Łódź (Poland)

Your everyday challenges:

  • Use AI-assisted engineering where it improves delivery - including infrastructure tooling, automation, documentation and runbooks.

  • Build and operate Kubernetes infrastructure across two sites using infrastructure-as-code and automated delivery.

  • Design deployment mechanisms that allow long-lived connections to drain gracefullyinstead of being dropped during releases.

  • Take ownership of platform networking, including stable ingress and egress IPs, Layer 4 load balancing, TLS and connectivity coordinated with an external infrastructure provider.

  • Build and operate the observability stack: metrics, logs, dashboards and alerting that provide useful signal rather than noise.

  • Design monitoring around real production behaviour, including visibility into individual connections and failure modes.

  • Own certificate lifecycle, secrets management and platform access control.

  • Operate PostgreSQL in a highly available environment, including replication, failover, backups and verified restores.

  • Design and exercise backup and disaster-recovery procedures across two sites.

  • Work closely with engineers and QA on performance and production-scale load testing, investigating what fails first and why.

  • Support the platform during migration and production cutovers.

  • Take part in production incident response and from the steady-state phase, a 24×7 on-call rotation.

What are we looking for?

  • Experience with telecom, carrier, messaging or other environments built around persistent network connections.

  • Knowledge of SMPP, SIP, SS7 or similar telecom protocols.

  • Strong production experience operating Kubernetes on self-managed, on-premise or similarly infrastructure-heavy environments - not only managed cloud services.

  • Experience with stateful, long-lived TCP workloads on Kubernetes, including connection draining, stable ingress/egress, Layer 4 load balancing and deployment behaviour.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals. You are comfortable diagnosing problems involving routing, NAT, firewalls, MTU, TLS or packet-level behaviour.

  • Practical troubleshooting experience with tools such as tcpdump and production network diagnostics.

  • Experience designing monitoring and alerting, not only maintaining dashboards somebody else created. You understand what deserves to wake a human up, and what does not.

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD experience for containerised systems.

  • Practical PostgreSQL operations experience, including replication, failover, backup and importantly - verified restore.

  • Ability to work directly with engineers from external infrastructure and network providers.

  • Professional English.

  • Real production on-call and incident-response experience.

What will strengthen your candidacy?

  • Experience configuring or troubleshooting IPsec connectivity with external parties.

  • Experience designing or operating multi-site active-active or active-passive environments.

  • Hands-on disaster-recovery exercises rather than DR plans that existed only on paper.

  • Performance engineering experience, including Linux kernel or network tuning for high connection counts.

  • Security hardening experience, including CIS-style benchmarks, vulnerability management or software supply-chain practices.

  • Experience being the first SRE or Platform Engineer on a system and defining how it should be operated.

Why join us?

  • Build it and run it: you won’t inherit an infrastructure somebody else designed or throw your work over the wall after launch. You’ll help build the platform and remain close to it in production.

  • A genuinely difficult reliability problem: long-lived protocol traffic, stateful connections, two-site infrastructure and production traffic at telecom scale.

  • Influence architecture from day one: deployment, observability and operability are design constraints here, not tasks postponed until after development.

  • Greenfield infrastructure: you’ll have real influence over how the Kubernetes platform, delivery pipelines, monitoring and operational practices are created.

  • Small senior team: short decision paths and direct collaboration with engineers and the solution architect.

  • Production ownership: you’ll follow the system through build, migration, hypercare and steady-state operation instead of disappearing after implementation.

  • Modern engineering environment: automation and AI-assisted tooling are used where they genuinely improve engineering and operational work.

Sounds like a fit? Let’s talk! 🚀
