At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Information

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:00pm EST

Program Overview

Help us elevate our patient care to a whole new level! Join our Community Care team as an industry leader in serving our members by utilizing best-in-class operating and clinical models. You can have life-changing impact on our Community Care members. Community Care is a member centric, team-delivered, community-based care management model that joins members where they are. Develops, implements and supports Health Strategies, tactics, policies and programs that ensure the delivery of benefits and to establish overall member wellness and successful and timely return to work. Services and strategies, policies and programs are comprised of network management, clinical coverage, and policies.

Community Care Case Manager use a collaborative process of assessment, planning, facilitation, care coordination, evaluation, and advocacy for options and services to meet an individual’s and family’s comprehensive health needs through communication and available resources to promote quality, cost effective outcomes.

Education

40

$60,522.00 - $129,615.00

As part of our growing Data & AI Enablement team, you’ll work directly with construction professionals and business leaders to understand their workflows, build prototypes, and deliver useful solutions. Projects may include replacing spreadsheet processes, building staffing and resource planning applications, and improving visibility into project operations.

This role combines business discovery with hands-on software development. You’ll use AI-assisted development to move quickly, partner closely with our data platform owner, and take solutions from initial conversations through deployment and improvement. You’ll have direct access to users, ownership of meaningful work, and the opportunity to shape tools used across projects and regions.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from any location within the US where AECOM has an office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work directly with business leaders and construction teams to understand workflows, clarify ambiguous needs, and define requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Design and build internal applications, automations, and data products, working across user interfaces, application logic, databases, and APIs as needed.
  • Rapidly prototype and validate solutions with users, choosing practical approaches across AI-assisted coding, traditional development, low-code tools, and existing technology.
  • Partner with Data & Integration Engineering to connect applications to governed enterprise and project data, using consistent data definitions and established technical standards.
  • Own delivery from discovery through deployment, including testing, documentation, stakeholder communication, and coordination of technical dependencies and blockers.
  • Measure adoption and business impact, improve solutions based on feedback, and turn successful tools into reusable capabilities across teams, projects, and regions.

This is a remote night-shift position focused on engaging prospective students and professionals, understanding their career goals, counselling them on suitable SAP career paths, following up with inquiries, and converting qualified prospects into enrollments.

SAP Career Counselling

  • Convert qualified leads into counselling appointments and paid enrollments.
  • Re-engage older leads and maintain an active prospect pipeline.
  • Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, follow-ups, lead status, and conversions in the CRM.
  • Consistently work toward weekly and monthly lead-generation and enrollment targets.

Core Responsibilities

  • Explain schedules, tuition fees, payment options and program expectations

  • Maintain complete CRM and Google Sheets records
  • Meet daily lead-generation, counselling and follow-up targets
  • Achieve weekly and monthly enrollment targets
  • Prepare activity, pipeline and conversion reports

North American Working Hours

This role requires consistent availability during North American Eastern Time business hours.

Candidates working from India must be prepared to work a permanent night shift.

The expected shift will generally fall within:

Approximately 6:30 p.m. to 3:30 a.m. India Standard Time

The exact schedule may change based on daylight-saving time, campaign requirements and the assigned Canadian or United States market.

Candidates must:

  • Be available throughout the assigned North American shift
  • Have a quiet and professional home-working environment
  • Maintain reliable attendance and punctuality
  • Be comfortable making calls during Indian night hours
  • Be available for scheduled counselling appointments with Canadian and United States prospects

Candidates who cannot work a permanent night shift aligned with North American hours should not apply.

Target-Based Performance Measures

Performance will be measured through:

  • Self-generated leads
  • Qualified North American prospects
  • Daily outbound calls and messages
  • Meaningful counselling sessions
  • Appointments scheduled and attended
  • Follow-up completion rate
  • Applications generated
  • Payment conversions
  • Lead-to-enrollment conversion
  • Monthly verified enrollments
  • CRM accuracy
  • Ethical and compliant counselling

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma or post-secondary education
  • Minimum three years of experience in lead generation, B2C sales, EdTech sales, educational counselling, admissions, student recruitment, telesales or inside sales
  • Proven ability to generate leads independently
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Strong telephone-sales and presentation skills
  • Comfortable with cold calling and outbound prospecting
  • Strong objection-handling and closing skills
  • Experience working with sales or enrollment targets
  • Strong follow-up discipline
  • Experience using CRM systems, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and video-meeting platforms
  • Reliable computer, professional headset and high-speed internet connection
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Mandatory availability during North American business hours

Compensation

Monthly salary: ₹11,486.06–₹37,482.00

Final compensation will depend on experience, English communication, lead-generation capability, counselling performance and verified results.

Performance-based incentives and career-growth opportunities may be available.

Job Details

Job Type: Full-time
Work Location: Remote from India
Shift: Permanent night shift
Market Covered: Canada and the United States
Working Schedule: North American Eastern Time business hours
Approximate India Schedule: 6:30 p.m.–3:30 a.m. IST, subject to daylight-saving and operational requirements
Experience: Minimum three years

  • Are you willing to work a permanent night shift aligned with North American business hours?

  • Are you comfortable making outbound calls to candidates in Canada and the United States?
  • Which CRM and lead-management tools have you used?
  • Do you have a reliable computer, professional headset, quiet workspace and high-speed internet connection?

Candidates who cannot work North American business hours or who depend entirely on company-provided leads should not apply.

Benefits:

Application Question(s):

  • Do you have prior experience in education/training sales, career counselling, SAP/IT training sales, or inside sales?
  • Are you comfortable working a full-time night shift aligned with U.S./Canadian business hours?

Requirements

Please submit your updated resume at and a brief note outlining your experience in educational sales, outbound calling, lead conversion, CRM management, and North American customer support. Shortlisted candidates will undergo an initial screening followed by an interview

raw.description:
About Meal Ticket

Meal Ticket is a PE-backed vertical SaaS company for the foodservice industry. Our platform runs the back of house for restaurant operators and the demand side for distributors and suppliers, serving more than 15,000 restaurants worldwide. Operators on our platform typically cut food costs 3-5% and reclaim roughly 100 hours a month.

Please note: you must reside in one of the following states to qualify for this role - AZ, CT, FL, GA, ID, IN, KS, MI, MO, NC, NH, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA

The role

We're hiring a builder to own GTM operations for the Revenue and CS orgs, reporting directly to the CRO.

This is a dual-focused role; half of it is the reporting infrastructure the business runs on: CRM architecture and data hygiene, forecasting and pipeline inspection, territory, quota and comp administration, deal desk, and the funnel and attainment reporting we forecast from and the other half is building: agentic workflows, enrichment and routing automation, AI-assisted prospecting and research pipelines, and internal GTM tools.

The function exists to raise output per rep rather than fund growth with headcount. You'll be measured on qualified pipeline per rep, speed to lead, MQL-to-SQL conversion, cycle time and cost per SQL, alongside forecast accuracy and data integrity.

You own what you build after launch, not just at launch: monitoring, fixing, and retiring agents when they stop earning their keep. Everything deployed goes through security review, runs in a sandbox before touching production data, and includes a human review step wherever a wrong output would be costly.

We're looking for someone who builds, not someone who maintains and doesn't simply view the role as dashboards and reporting. It's equal parts running a sustainable RevOps reporting operation and building go-to-market agents, and experience limited to configuring off-the-shelf SaaS tools doesn't meet the bar for the GTM engineering half.

What you'll own

Reporting & revenue operations

  • Salesforce architecture and data integrity (in partnership with SysOps), including the object model, field governance, and a named owner for every critical field.
  • The forecast and pipeline inspection cadence the CRO runs the business on, measured on forecast accuracy against commit.
  • Territory design, quota setting, and comp plan administration across Sales and CS.
  • Deal desk throughput: approvals cleared within SLA against defined discount thresholds.
  • Funnel and attainment reporting by stage, segment, channel and rep.

GTM engineering & automation

  • Agentic workflows designed, deployed and maintained in production: lead research and enrichment, call and email analysis, pipeline hygiene enforcement, and rep-facing answers over CRM data.
  • Enrichment, routing and speed-to-lead automation from form fill to rep contact.
  • Security review, sandbox-to-production promotion, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for everything you ship, within our AI governance framework.

What you bring

  • 4+ years in RevOps or sales/marketing operations in B2B SaaS.
  • Salesforce admin and architecture experience, including custom development.
  • Hands-on experience building with APIs, scripting, or workflow orchestration tools.
  • Experience designing and deploying LLM or agent-based workflows that other people rely on in their work.
  • Strong attention to detail, self-starter and ability to work autonomously effectively.
  • Comfort being measured on forecast accuracy and rep productivity.
  • Ability to effectively work and influence cross-functionally at all levels of an organization.
  • Vertical B2B SaaS experience; restaurant, hospitality or foodservice tech is a plus but not required.

How we operate

Salesforce is our system of record. We use Gong for conversation data and HubSpot for marketing automation. Work is prioritized in weekly agile sprints and managed like a product roadmap.

This is a player-coach role: you'll work hands-on alongside a fractional RevOps partner.

What success looks like after 3-6 months

  • The CRO forecasts off your numbers without manually scrubbing them.
  • Data is clean, and every critical field has a named owner.
  • The deal desk consistently clears within SLA.
  • A set of agentic workflows runs in production with measurable impact on qualified pipeline per rep and speed to lead.

Compensation

Competitive base plus performance bonus.

Salary: $150-175k OTE

Director of Key Accounts, Amazon

Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer

Department: Commercial

Compensation: $125,000 to $185,000 annual salary

Location: Preferably the NY Metro area, but open to the possibility of remote status

The Role

Bubble is looking for a Director of Amazon to lead one of our most important growth channels - owning the full P&L, the strategic vision, and the day-to-day performance that brings that vision to life. Amazon is currently supported by an external agency partner, and this person will direct that relationship closely, setting priorities and holding it accountable to a clear strategy and KPIs. Just as importantly, they will define where Amazon at Bubble goes from here: the long-term growth strategy, and the operating structure - people, partners, and capabilities - needed to deliver it.

This is a role for someone who can operate at both altitudes - setting the strategic direction for a fast-growing, highly competitive channel, and getting into the weeds of listings, creative, advertising, and inventory to make sure that direction actually shows up in the numbers.

What You'll Own

Strategy, Vision & P&L

  • Full ownership of the Amazon P&L - revenue, margin, and profitable, sustainable growth, not just top-line
  • Own the multi-year vision and roadmap for Amazon at Bubble, including the long-term structure and capabilities needed to get there
  • Build and manage the Amazon calendar (launches, promotions, deals, seasonal moments) in lockstep with the broader commercial calendar
  • Direct the external Amazon agency relationship day to day: set the strategy, brief and prioritize their work, and hold them to clear KPIs
  • Serve as the internal voice and authority on Amazon, partnering with commercial, brand, creative, finance, and operations to keep channel strategy aligned to broader business goals

Listing, SEO & Content Performance

  • Be the internal expert on Amazon SEO, search algorithm behavior, and listing optimization - know what drives discoverability and conversion, and why
  • Own content strategy across the catalog: A+ content, brand store, enhanced content, and new listing launches
  • Monitor and resolve listing and account health issues, including Buy Box, suppressions, and compliance
  • Own creative strategy for Amazon (detail pages, storefront) and have direct input into paid media ad creative

Advertising & Test-and-Learn

  • Have input into and oversight of the full Amazon advertising strategy - Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP - directing agency and/or resources executing it
  • Design and run structured test-and-learn programs across listings, creative, and campaigns, and turn results into a repeatable playbook
  • Monitor and adjust ad investment to maximize ROI and hit sales and profitability targets
  • Deeply data-oriented: fluent in the full Amazon metric set (CVR, Buy Box, RoAS, ACoS, TACoS, ASP, NTB) and comfortable building your own analysis rather than waiting for a dashboard

Operational Excellence & Inventory

  • Partner closely with demand planning and operations to ensure accurate forecasting, healthy in-stock rates, and efficient FBA inventory management
  • Balance inventory investment against sell-through and profitability - minimizing both stockouts and excess/aged inventory
  • Monitor and troubleshoot operational issues (shipments, reconciliation, chargebacks) that affect account health or the P&L

Customer & Brand Experience

  • Monitor customer reviews, ratings, and feedback, and use those insights to inform product, content, and CX improvements
  • Implement strategies to protect and grow a strong review and ratings profile

Reporting & Executive Communication

  • Deliver executive-level reporting on channel performance, translating data into clear strategic recommendations for leadership
  • Represent Amazon in leadership forecasting and commercial reviews, translating performance into narrative that connects to the broader business

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in Amazon account management/eCommerce, ideally in beauty, CPG, or a similarly fast-moving, competitive category
  • Track record of owning a P&L and driving profitable, sustainable growth - not just sales volume
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of Amazon SEO, listing optimization, and Amazon advertising (Sponsored Products/Brands/Display; DSP a plus)
  • Working knowledge of FBA inventory management and demand forecasting
  • Experience directing an agency or freelance partner, with the judgment to know when to push back
  • Sharp analytical instincts - comfortable in the data, not just consuming summaries of it
  • A point of view on creative and what performs on Amazon specifically, not just brand marketing more broadly
  • Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to translate complex performance data into clear business recommendations
  • Bias toward action - equally comfortable setting strategy and doing the hands-on work to prove it out

raw.title: GTM Readiness Manager
raw.excerpt: Role DescriptionAs a GTM Readiness Manager within the GTM organization, you will help turn product and business changes into executable go-to-market motions.
raw.description:
Role Description

As a GTM Readiness Manager within the GTM organization, you will help turn product and business changes into executable go-to-market motions. You will work across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Enablement, and Technology to ensure the business is operationally ready to bring new products, packaging, and other commercial changes to market.

You will play a critical role in translating product decisions into GTM requirements, identifying cross-functional dependencies, coordinating operational readiness, and ensuring the end-to-end customer and seller experience works as intended. This role sits at the intersection of product and commercial execution, giving you broad exposure across the business and the opportunity to improve how we bring increasingly complex products and commercial models to market.

You will serve as a critical connection point between Product and the teams responsible for bringing product changes to market, ensuring teams are aligned and operationally ready for launch. You will also help build and scale the GTM Readiness capability, creating clearer processes, identifying dependencies earlier, reducing launch friction, and enabling teams to move faster and execute with greater confidence.

Responsibilities

  • Own GTM readiness for product and commercial changes, including new product launches, pricing and packaging changes, new SKUs, migrations, deprecations, and changes to routes to market.
  • Translate product decisions into commercial and operational requirements across areas such as product catalog, pricing and approvals, contracting, Salesforce/CPQ, billing and ordering, provisioning and entitlements, compensation, reporting, and customer lifecycle.
  • Partner with Product teams early in the development lifecycle to understand upcoming changes, identify impacted GTM motions, and establish the decisions, owners, dependencies, and lead times required for readiness.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional readiness across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Enablement, GTM Technology, and other impacted teams, while maintaining clear accountability with the teams that own individual decisions and deliverables.
  • Drive end-to-end operational validation, defining critical business scenarios and ensuring appropriate owners validate the complete customer and seller experience across quoting, ordering, provisioning, billing, reporting, renewal, support, and other applicable workflows.
  • Identify and manage readiness risks, surfacing unresolved decisions, dependencies, and operational gaps early and driving them toward resolution or explicit risk acceptance before launch.
  • Improve the GTM Readiness operating model by creating reusable processes, launch patterns, requirements frameworks, and automation that reduce manual coordination and make future launches faster and more predictable.

Requirements

  • At least 8 years of overall professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Business Systems, or another role supporting complex cross-functional GTM initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting product launches, pricing/packaging changes, commercial model changes, or other initiatives requiring coordination between Product and GTM teams.
  • Working knowledge of core SaaS commercial processes, including multiple areas such as opportunity-to-order, quoting/CPQ, pricing, contracting, billing, provisioning, renewals, compensation, or customer lifecycle management.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product or business needs into clear operational requirements, dependencies, decisions, and execution plans.
  • Experience independently coordinating complex initiatives across Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Sales, and other business functions without direct authority over participating teams.
  • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to understand how a change in one part of the commercial lifecycle can affect downstream processes, systems, data, and customer experiences.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience documenting requirements, facilitating cross-functional decisions, communicating risks, and driving clarity among stakeholders with different priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a B2B SaaS or subscription-based business with multiple products, customer segments, or routes to market.
  • Experience with Salesforce, CPQ, billing, commerce, provisioning, entitlement, or other systems supporting the quote-to-cash/customer lifecycle.
  • Experience designing or improving product launch, commercialization, or GTM readiness processes rather than solely executing within an established process.
  • Experience supporting products sold through multiple motions, such as self-service, direct sales, channel, reseller, or partner ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with automation and AI capabilities that can simplify requirements gathering, dependency management, testing, and operational readiness.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

About Young Americans For Liberty

Founded after the 2008 Ron Paul Presidential Campaign, Young Americans for Liberty (YAL) is the nation’s largest pro-liberty youth movement, building a powerful network of activists to transform states into beacons of freedom.

We drive real change in America by working through our "Build - Elect - Pass" model:

  1. Build: We are building the largest nationwide movement of committed youth activists on American college campuses, with pro-liberty students fighting on hundreds of campuses across the country.
  2. Elect: We mobilize our base of committed youth activists to be the grassroots muscle on campaigns of principled liberty legislators through Operation Win at the Door. Since 2018, we've built a coalition of 400 active legislators in our National Liberty Legislator Coalition, and thousands of YAL-recruited students have knocked on over 6 million doors to turn out the vote.
  3. Pass: We train this coalition of principled liberty legislators to pass transformative policy at the state level. This coalition has already passed over 1,250 pro-liberty bills spanning from Universal School Choice, to Constitutional Carry, to major tax cuts and so much more. You can view the full list of bills passed at.

Mission & Vision

Our mission is to identify, educate, train, and mobilize youth activists committed to the ideals of liberty and the Constitution. Our vision is to create Liberty Lighthouse States that will Transform Our States into Beacons of Liberty. YAL also works to achieve this vision by electing liberty legislators and passing liberty legislation.

Our Values & Culture

YAL's culture is built on 5 foundational values:

  1. Goal Setting: We orient our work towards specific goals that align with achieving our long-term vision.
  2. Trust the Truth: We pursue the truth and are honest in all we do, even when it’s difficult. There should never be a situation where lying is the right answer if we’re truthful from the beginning.
  3. Grassroots Mobilization: We win on principle by generating grassroots pressure on the politicians. Unless you are politically feared, you will not be politically respected. Education alone is not enough.
  4. Principle: We believe in liberty — which provides the freedom to choose and requires taking responsibility for your choices — and individual rights — which must be respected at all times.
  5. Power of the Individual: We recognize everyone has an innate ability to make a difference. Therefore, we are dedicated to aligning your goals and developing your strengths so you can unlock your full potential.

Candidates who will fit in with YAL's culture tend to be principled, entrepreneurial, passionate, and comfortable with ambitious goals and a fast-paced work environment.

Great marketing ideas only matter if they're executed flawlessly.

Young Americans for Liberty is looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist who takes pride in precision, organization, and flawless execution. Every email, text message, digital ad, and web update you deploy helps engage donors, mobilize activists, and support YAL's mission.

If you're the type of person who catches small mistakes, enjoys process-driven work, and takes pride in getting every detail right, you'll fit right in.

About the role

The Digital Marketing Specialist is responsible for deploying digital communications across Young Americans for Liberty and the Young Americans for Liberty Foundation. Working closely with the Marketing team, you'll deploy communications across multiple digital platforms, manage audience data, publish content, and ensure every deployment is accurate and on time.

Success in this role is measured by accuracy, consistency, and speed. This role rewards execution. Demonstrate consistent accuracy, reliability, and ownership, and you'll have opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and help improve Marketing operations.

This position reports directly to the Director of Digital Marketing.

📍 Location: Fully remote (hybrid available for candidates located in Austin, TX)

What you'll do

Execute digital communications

  • Build, schedule, and deploy marketing emails, P2P/A2P text messages, press releases, and social media ads
  • Execute rapid-response communications when priorities shift
  • Leverage AI tools to improve speed, accuracy, and efficiency

Manage audience data

  • Build and maintain audience lists in HubSpot
  • Apply tagging, segmentation, and attribution standards
  • Ensure every communication reaches the intended audience

Publish content and coordinate communications

  • Publish blog posts and website content through Webflow
  • Deploy content through the YAL Action Center
  • Coordinate with external vendors on live calls and robocalls
  • Support social media publishing as needed

Improve marketing operations

  • Support additional Marketing projects as priorities shift
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows and operational efficiency
  • Review deployment performance data and identify opportunities to improve future deployments

What Success Looks Like

  • Digital communications are consistently deployed accurately, on time, and without operational errors.
  • Standard operating procedures are followed with exceptional attention to detail
  • Audience lists, tagging, and attribution remain accurate
  • AI tools are incorporated into daily workflows to improve speed and accuracy.
  • Consistent execution creates opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and operational improvements.

Qualifications

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to execute repetitive, process-driven work accurately and consistently
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to quickly learn new software and platforms
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines while maintaining a high degree of accuracy
  • Experience using Google Workspace or Microsoft Office
  • Strong communication skills, including proactively communicating deadlines, resource needs, and potential issues
  • Strongly aligned with Young Americans for Liberty’s mission and principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with HubSpot or other CRM/email marketing platforms
  • Experience with Webflow, Meta Ads, or SMS/text platforms
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini

Compensation & Benefits

Benefits include:

At Ironmark, we combine strategy, creativity, technology, and data to help organizations grow. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and delivering measurable results for clients across a wide range of industries.

As a Senior Digital Marketing Strategist, you’ll have the opportunity to influence meaningful client outcomes, collaborate with talented specialists, and help shape the future of integrated digital marketing.

Founded in 2013, Fusemachines is a global provider of enterprise AI products and services, on a mission to democratize AI. Fusemachines serves companies in industries such as retail, manufacturing, and government.

Fusemachines continues to actively pursue the mission of democratizing AI for the masses by providing high-quality AI education in underserved communities and helping organizations achieve their full potential with AI.

Type: Remote, Full-time

Key Objective:

The Sr. UX/UI Designer sits on a product team and owns the design of a product area, connecting real user needs with business goals. This designer thinks like a product owner and understands how the product earns its keep. Craft and research fundamentals stay non negotiable, and AI is the working partner that makes it possible to explore more options and prove ideas faster.Key Objective:

Qualifications and Experience:

  • At least 5 years of UX/UI design experience, with a portfolio of products that shipped.

  • Demonstrated use of AI in real design work, with examples of what it changed.

Required skills/competencies:

AI fluency and vibe design

  • Fluent with current AI design, prototyping, and coding tools such as Figma Make, Claude, Cursor, v0, or Lovable, and quick to learn the next ones.

  • Vibe designs with intent, going from rough idea to working prototype in hours by steering AI with a trained eye.

  • Treats a prompt like a design brief, giving AI the context, constraints, and design system rules it needs.

  • Uses AI across the process, from research synthesis and UX copy to edge cases, accessibility checks, and QA.

  • Can tell a fast AI output from a good one, and sets the tool aside when doing it by hand is better.

Designing AI products

  • Designs for systems that do not give the same answer twice, handling uncertainty, wrong answers, and partial results without losing the user's trust.

  • Understands how models and agents behave well enough to set honest expectations and place human review where being wrong is costly.

  • Thinks past the chat box, designing agentic and assisted workflows rather than defaulting to conversation.

Product and business thinking

  • Knows how the product makes money, who it serves, and what the success metrics and constraints are, and designs with that in view.

  • Weighs desirability, feasibility, and viability, and can say no to an idea that is not worth what it costs.

  • Argues design decisions in terms stakeholders care about, such as conversion, retention, or time to ship.

Design fundamentals

  • Strong visual and interaction craft in Figma, and the judgment to run a design system rather than only work inside one.

  • Research and usability testing that ends in decisions, not decks.

  • Enough code literacy to read a component, change it, and steer an AI coding tool.

  • Clear communication in English, able to explain and defend decisions to non designers.

  • Owns the process end to end, scoping, prioritizing, and delivering independently.

Good to have

  • A degree in design, computer science, information technology, or a related field.

  • Production front end experience with HTML, CSS, SASS, or React.

  • Prompt libraries or reusable AI workflows built for a team.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the design of a product area end to end, partnering with product and engineering on the goals and constraints behind the roadmap.

  • Take ideas to clickable prototypes quickly, and use them to drive decisions instead of slides.

  • Run research and usability testing, and bring the findings to the people making the calls.

  • Stay with the work after release, watching how it performs and iterating.

  • Maintain and extend the design system so people and AI tools produce on brand, accessible output by default.

  • Share prompts, workflows, and failed experiments to raise the team's AI fluency.

  • Own the quality of everything you deliver. Nothing ships without a designer's review, AI assisted or not.

Position Summary

Ironmark is seeking a strategic, analytical, and client-focused Senior Digital Marketing Strategist to lead integrated marketing strategy across a portfolio of client accounts.

This role serves as the strategic bridge between client business objectives and marketing execution, partnering with clients, account teams, and channel specialists to develop growth-focused strategies that drive measurable business outcomes. The Senior Digital Marketing Strategist is responsible for aligning marketing initiatives across the customer journey, translating performance data into actionable recommendations, and ensuring execution supports broader business goals.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, marketing expertise, and analytical thinking with the ability to build trusted client relationships and influence cross-functional teams. This role does not directly manage personnel but plays a critical leadership role in shaping strategy, guiding execution, and driving client success.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy & Leadership

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor for assigned client accounts.
  • Lead strategic planning initiatives, quarterly business reviews, growth discussions, and client consultations.
  • Translate business goals into integrated marketing strategies and actionable roadmaps.
  • Present strategic recommendations, performance insights, and growth opportunities to client stakeholders.
  • Build trusted relationships through proactive consultation and strategic guidance.

Integrated Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and oversee integrated marketing strategies across paid media, SEO, AEO, content marketing, email marketing, local marketing, analytics, and emerging digital channels.
  • Ensure channel initiatives work cohesively throughout the customer journey and support business objectives.
  • Collaborate with channel specialists to align tactical execution with strategic priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve performance through audience targeting, conversion optimization, content alignment, media mix adjustments, and cross-channel coordination.
  • Stay informed on emerging technologies, AI-driven search experiences, and evolving consumer behavior.

Performance & Growth Planning

  • Analyze marketing performance data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and growth drivers.
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
  • Develop testing roadmaps and optimization plans designed to improve business outcomes.
  • Recommend channel investment strategies and budget allocation.
  • Identify opportunities for account growth and expanded service adoption.
  • Lead strategic onboarding and discovery efforts for new client engagements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Paid Media, SEO, Content, Creative, Analytics, Development, Local Marketing, and Account Management teams to ensure coordinated execution.
  • Provide strategic guidance while respecting channel ownership and subject matter expertise.
  • Support internal teams with market research, competitive insights, and strategic recommendations.
  • Contribute to agency thought leadership, process improvements, and strategic best practices.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 4–7 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, account strategy, marketing consulting, or agency environments.
  • Experience presenting recommendations and performance insights to clients or business stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of integrated digital marketing strategy and how multiple channels work together to drive business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated expertise in multiple digital marketing disciplines and working knowledge across paid, organic, content, local, email, and analytics channels.
  • Experience analyzing marketing performance data and translating insights into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred

  • Agency experience managing multiple client accounts.
  • Experience supporting multi-location, healthcare, multifamily, higher education, franchise, or B2B marketing programs.
  • Familiarity with GA4, Looker Studio, CRM platforms, marketing automation platforms, and reporting tools.
  • Understanding of AI-powered search experiences, AEO, attribution frameworks, and conversion optimization.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • You naturally connect business goals to marketing strategy.
  • You enjoy solving complex marketing challenges and uncovering growth opportunities.
  • You can confidently communicate with clients, executives, and channel specialists.
  • You think beyond individual tactics and understand how channels work together throughout the customer journey.
  • You are comfortable using data to inform decisions and recommendations.
  • You balance strategic thinking with accountability and execution.
  • You stay curious about emerging trends in AI, search, media, and digital marketing.

Why Join Ironmark

At Ironmark, we combine strategy, creativity, technology, and data to help organizations grow. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and delivering measurable results for clients across a wide range of industries.

As a Senior Digital Marketing Strategist, you’ll have the opportunity to influence meaningful client outcomes, collaborate with talented specialists, and help shape the future of integrated digital marketing.

  • Use cutting-edge tools and AI to make work smarter.

Description

We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, a multitasker, and a demonstrated team player. What You Will Do

  • Develop a scalable data platform integrating multiple sources for easy access.
  • Design and enhance data tools (orchestration, governance, Data-Lakehouse, BI, etc.).
  • Ensure smooth operation of data systems for analysts, scientists, and engineers.
  • Optimize data pipelines (ingestion, processing, and output) in a microservices environment.
  • Build, maintain, and monitor ETL/ELT processes and orchestrate workflows using Temporal.
  • Troubleshoot and improve the performance, scalability, and reliability of the data infrastructure (S3, Apache Iceberg, ClickHouse).
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, analysts, and backend engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data infrastructure role.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience with data modeling.
  • Experience with data lake/lakehouse architectures (e.g., Apache Iceberg, S3, or similar).
  • Experience with analytical / columnar databases (e.g., ClickHouse or similar).
  • Experience building and orchestrating ETL/ELT pipelines (e.g., Temporal, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or Scala/Java.
  • Experience working within a microservices architecture and cloud environments (AWS preferred).
  • Self-motivated, strong multitasking skills, and a demonstrated team player.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark (or similar technologies) for large-scale data processing.
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.
  • Note: this role is focused on batch data processing (not real-time streaming).

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with and contributing to open-source data platforms and tools.
  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Superset, Looker, Tableau, Metabase, or similar).
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience with AWS EMR and running Apache Spark workloads in a cloud environment.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to boost engineering productivity.

About Fusemachines

Founded in 2013, Fusemachines is a global provider of enterprise AI products and services, on a mission to democratize AI. Leveraging proprietary AI Studio and AI Engines, the company helps drive the clients’ AI Enterprise Transformation, regardless of where they are in their Digital AI journeys. With offices in North America, Asia, and Latin America, Fusemachines provides a suite of enterprise AI offerings and specialty services that allow organizations of any size to implement and scale AI. Fusemachines serves companies in industries such as retail, manufacturing, and government.

Fusemachines continues to actively pursue the mission of democratizing AI for the masses by providing high-quality AI education in underserved communities and helping organizations achieve their full potential with AI.

Type: Remote, Full-time

Key Objective:

The Sr. UX/UI Designer sits on a product team and owns the design of a product area, connecting real user needs with business goals. This designer thinks like a product owner and understands how the product earns its keep. Craft and research fundamentals stay non negotiable, and AI is the working partner that makes it possible to explore more options and prove ideas faster.Key Objective:

Qualifications and Experience:

  • At least 5 years of UX/UI design experience, with a portfolio of products that shipped.

  • Demonstrated use of AI in real design work, with examples of what it changed.

Required skills/competencies:

AI fluency and vibe design

  • Fluent with current AI design, prototyping, and coding tools such as Figma Make, Claude, Cursor, v0, or Lovable, and quick to learn the next ones.

  • Vibe designs with intent, going from rough idea to working prototype in hours by steering AI with a trained eye.

  • Treats a prompt like a design brief, giving AI the context, constraints, and design system rules it needs.

  • Uses AI across the process, from research synthesis and UX copy to edge cases, accessibility checks, and QA.

  • Can tell a fast AI output from a good one, and sets the tool aside when doing it by hand is better.

Designing AI products

  • Designs for systems that do not give the same answer twice, handling uncertainty, wrong answers, and partial results without losing the user's trust.

  • Understands how models and agents behave well enough to set honest expectations and place human review where being wrong is costly.

  • Thinks past the chat box, designing agentic and assisted workflows rather than defaulting to conversation.

Product and business thinking

  • Knows how the product makes money, who it serves, and what the success metrics and constraints are, and designs with that in view.

  • Weighs desirability, feasibility, and viability, and can say no to an idea that is not worth what it costs.

  • Argues design decisions in terms stakeholders care about, such as conversion, retention, or time to ship.

Design fundamentals

  • Strong visual and interaction craft in Figma, and the judgment to run a design system rather than only work inside one.

  • Research and usability testing that ends in decisions, not decks.

  • Enough code literacy to read a component, change it, and steer an AI coding tool.

  • Clear communication in English, able to explain and defend decisions to non designers.

  • Owns the process end to end, scoping, prioritizing, and delivering independently.

Good to have

  • A degree in design, computer science, information technology, or a related field.

  • Production front end experience with HTML, CSS, SASS, or React.

  • Prompt libraries or reusable AI workflows built for a team.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the design of a product area end to end, partnering with product and engineering on the goals and constraints behind the roadmap.

  • Take ideas to clickable prototypes quickly, and use them to drive decisions instead of slides.

  • Run research and usability testing, and bring the findings to the people making the calls.

  • Stay with the work after release, watching how it performs and iterating.

  • Maintain and extend the design system so people and AI tools produce on brand, accessible output by default.

  • Share prompts, workflows, and failed experiments to raise the team's AI fluency.

  • Own the quality of everything you deliver. Nothing ships without a designer's review, AI assisted or not.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local.

  • Engenharia e Performance no Frontend:Desenvolver uma interface reativa e fluida utilizando React 18, Vite e TypeScript. Você aplicará técnicas de virtualização (TanStack Virtual v3) para renderizar grandes volumes de dados em tela sem onerar o navegador.
  • Gestão de Estado e Draft Mode: Implementar lógicas de negócios complexas no cliente, gerenciando estados de alta frequência via Zustand e TanStack Query, além de sincronizar de forma eficiente as edições de rascunhos (drafts) com o backend.
  • Desenvolvimento Backend:Construir e dar manutenção em serviços utilizando Kotlin K2 e Spring Boot. Você garantirá que fluxos de consolidação e aprovação não bloqueiem a thread HTTP, integrando-se adequadamente a mecanismos de orquestração assíncrona.
  • Persistência e Governança: Atuar com banco de dados PostgreSQL (RDS), elaborando migrações com Flyway e respeitando as restrições arquiteturais da plataforma (como a segregação rigorosa de leitura e escrita entre schemas).
  • Visualização de Dados e Segurança:Implementar a camada gráfica exclusivamente com Recharts e integrar o fluxo de autenticação e carteirização de serviços via Microsoft Entra ID (Azure ID) e SSO (JWT).
  • Experiência consolidada como Fullstack Sênior: Perfil preferencialmente T-shaped, com domínio técnico em Frontend para liderar os desafios da interface, aliado a uma forte autonomia para atuar em Backend.
  • Sólida vivência no Ecossistema React:Prática comprovada com React moderno, TypeScript, gerenciamento de estado (Zustand) e estratégias de data-fetching (TanStack Query), com foco em otimização de performance e manipulação de arrays complexos.
  • Capacidade em Backend (Kotlin/Java):Habilidade para desenvolver, refatorar e dar manutenção em APIs RESTful robustas usando Kotlin e Spring Boot, aplicando boas práticas de Clean Code.
  • Banco de Dados Relacional: Bom domínio prático em PostgreSQL, modelagem relacional básica e versionamento de schemas utilizando Flyway.
  • Integração de Fluxos Assíncronos: Compreensão arquitetural para integrar aplicações clientes com processos não-bloqueantes e serviços em nuvem.
Diferencial:
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de nuvem AWS (ex: hospedagem estática em Amazon S3/CloudFront, API Gateway, runtime em Amazon EKS e orquestração via AWS Step Functions).
  • Experiência em migrar fluxos de planejamento baseados em planilhas pesadas (Excel) para aplicações web de alta performance.

Preferred Qualifications

raw.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video:
  • Our careers page:

As the Senior Marketing Ops Manager, you will own the technology, processes, and data foundations that power Marketing execution at Fleetio. Reporting to the Director of Marketing Operations, you will ensure our systems are connected, reliable, scalable, and equipped to support how Marketing generates, nurtures, routes, and measures demand.

This role is ideal for someone who is hands-on and can seamlessly move between business requirements and technical execution. You can evaluate processes, understand how data should flow across systems, configure and troubleshoot solutions, and clearly explain the implications to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Your Impact

Marketing Technology Ownership and Optimization

  • Own the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of Fleetio’s marketing technology stack, including marketing automation, attribution, inbound routing, enrichment, intent, advertising, webinar, event, and data automation platforms. Ensure the stack is connected, reliable, documented, and governed.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for Marketo architecture, administration, and troubleshooting.
  • Gather business requirements, identify technology and process gaps, and lead the implementation, integration, testing, and adoption of new capabilities.
  • Monitor system health, utilization, access, and vendor performance, identifying opportunities to simplify the stack, reduce manual work, control costs, and improve reliability.
  • Maintain documentation covering system ownership, architecture, integrations, dependencies, and change history.

Lifecycle, Routing, and Data Integrity

  • Implement and maintain lifecycle stages, lead and contact scoring, qualification, routing rules, SLAs, and handoffs across Marketing, SDR, and Sales. This includes the supporting systems, from inbound routing and scheduling tools such as Chili Piper to CRM and automation platforms.
  • Own the flow of marketing data across Salesforce, enrichment tools, and marketing automation platforms. Diagnose sync errors, field-mapping issues, and broken automations while improving data quality through normalization, deduplication, and enrichment using tools such as ZoomInfo and Clay.
  • Maintain consent, preference, suppression, and retention processes across marketing systems in support of GDPR, CCPA, and related requirements.
  • Maintain campaign and tracking infrastructure, including Salesforce Campaigns and hierarchies, UTM standards, forms, pixels, and events.
  • Own the operational health of attribution platforms such as Bizible. Build and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards that provide visibility into campaign performance, funnel conversion, and pipeline contribution, resolving discrepancies across platforms.
  • Partner with Sales Ops, Revenue Ops, GTM Systems, Data, and Web teams on integrations and shared data models.

Operational Excellence and Partnership

  • Serve as a technical and operational partner to Marketing teams, helping translate business goals into scalable processes and system solutions.
  • Manage incoming Marketing Operations requests by clarifying requirements, identifying dependencies, setting priorities, and communicating timelines and tradeoffs.
  • Create documentation and training that help marketers use systems correctly and understand how their work affects data quality, attribution, lifecycle management, and downstream teams.
  • Balance immediate execution needs with the long-term scalability, maintainability, and governance of the marketing technology environment. Proactively identify risks and opportunities and follow through on recommendations.

Your Experience

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in Marketing Operations, Marketing Technology, or Revenue Operations within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • An active Adobe Marketo Engage Business Practitioner Expert certification, or the current equivalent advanced Marketo certification, is required.
  • Experience owning and optimizing a broad marketing technology stack beyond a marketing automation platform.
  • Strong Salesforce experience, including Campaigns, reports and dashboards, fields and objects, and funnel and pipeline reporting.
  • Practical knowledge of APIs, webhooks, native integrations, data synchronization, and workflow automation.
  • Hands-on experience with lifecycle management, routing, lead-to-account matching, and Marketing-to-SDR handoffs.
  • Experience supporting integrated campaigns across demand generation, product marketing, customer marketing, events, and digital programs.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to trace issues across multiple platforms, validate data, and identify root causes.
  • Strong project management and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options
  • Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
  • Community service funds
  • Professional development funds
  • Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
  • Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
  • Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
  • Remote working friendly since 2012

This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will.

Intake Officer – Child, Youth & Family (QLD)

Make a real difference for children and young people across Queensland

  • Permanent Full Time | Work from Home (Queensland)
  • Monthly Rostered Day Off (RDO)
  • Salary Packaging Benefits + Career Development Opportunities

About Us

Every day, Life Without Barriers provides support and care to children and young people, as we work collaboratively with families, carers, and communities, to ensure they have the environment they deserve to grow. With a focus on ensuring safety and respect, this is an opportunity to make a positive and meaningful difference in these young lives and help pave a brighter future.

Life Without Barriers is a leading social purpose organisation of 8,000 employees working in more than 500 communities across Australia. We support children, young people and families, people with disability, older people, and people with mental illness. We work with people who are homeless and refugees and asylum seekers. Join a community of people dedicated to breaking down barriers.

We want to employ people who reflect the diversity of our clients to ensure we can support each client's individual needs and wants. We encourage people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander background and people with disability to apply.

About the Role

As the Intake Officer – Child, Youth & Family, you'll coordinate referrals, placement matching and intake processes for children and young people entering our care.

Working collaboratively with operational teams, carers and external stakeholders, you'll play a critical role in identifying safe, appropriate placements that meet each child's individual needs. You'll ensure referrals are managed efficiently, placement decisions are informed by best practice and CARE therapeutic principles, and carers receive the information and support they need during the placement process.

This is a full-time, maximum-term contract until 8 January 2027 and is a work-from-home opportunity that can be based anywhere in Queensland

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate referral, intake and placement matching for children and young people entering care.
  • Facilitate placement matching meetings and collaborate with Operational Managers, Therapeutic Practitioners, Cultural Support Planners, Carer Assessment & Engagement teams and other key stakeholders.
  • Gather, assess and document referral information to support informed placement decisions and service allocation.
  • Support carers through the initial stages of placement by providing relevant information about children's needs, routines, health and family connections.
  • Ensure placement decisions align with the CARE therapeutic framework and the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Child Placement Principles where applicable.
  • Manage funding applications relating to enhanced placements and additional support services.
  • Maintain accurate client, placement and carer records across internal and external systems.
  • Monitor placement capacity, vacancies and placement agreements while ensuring all documentation meets contractual and legislative requirements.
  • Develop strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to deliver responsive, high-quality service outcomes.
  • Contribute reporting and referral data to support service planning and carer attraction strategies.

Skills & Experience

You will bring:

  • A relevant Bachelor's Degree, preferably in Social Work, Social Welfare or Psychology.
  • Demonstrated experience within Child Protection, Out of Home Care or Child, Youth & Family Services.
  • Experience coordinating placements or managing placement risk within family-based and/or residential care.
  • Sound knowledge of the Queensland Child Protection system.
  • Understanding of the impacts of trauma, abuse, neglect and family separation on children and young people.
  • Experience working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams while managing competing priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build effective stakeholder relationships.
  • Experience using client management systems and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work autonomously.
  • Current Australian Driver Licence.

Successful candidates will be required to complete all relevant probity checks, including a National Criminal History Check and Working with Children Check where applicable.

What We Offer

  • Monthly Rostered Day Off (RDO)
  • Work from home flexibility
  • Salary packaging benefits to increase your take-home pay
  • Ongoing learning and professional development
  • Career progression across one of Australia's largest social purpose organisations
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture
  • Employee wellbeing and recognition programs

How to Apply

Include your resume and covering letter in one document, click ‘Apply’ and follow the prompts. For any enquiries including persons with disability that require adjustments, contact Joelene .

Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the advertisement may close earlier if a suitable candidate is identified. Current application closing date is midnight Sunday 4th October.

raw.description:
Remote | Full-time contract | Must be available to work US hours (EST)

About the Role

We’re hiring a Talent Operations Associate to support our fast-growing recruitment team. This is a full-time contract role (40 hours/week) ideal for someone early in their career with a strong interest in recruiting, operations, or HR. You’ll work alongside senior recruiters to help deliver an exceptional candidate experience while keeping everything running smoothly behind the scenes.

You won’t be reviewing resumes or sourcing candidates — instead, you’ll focus on owning operational workflows, handling candidate communications, and helping us run efficient, scalable hiring campaigns. You’ll also have the opportunity to shape how we work by providing feedback on tools, templates, and processes.

About Us

Rockstar blends human support and GenAI to deliver high-quality, flexible, and affordable recruiting solutions for smaller employers. Our clients typically have fewer than 50 employees and use our service to hire great talent for under $2K per role (~2–3% of first-year salary). We’re growing quickly and building a new kind of recruiting infrastructure for small businesses.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage day-to-day recruiting operations across multiple roles and client accounts
  • Respond to candidate inquiries and communicate with professionalism and empathy
  • Coordinate and track email campaigns to ensure timely candidate outreach
  • Monitor candidate scheduling, reschedules, and confirmations to keep the process on track
  • Provide feedback on communication templates, scheduling processes, and campaign tools to help us improve efficiency
  • Collaborate with US- and PH-based team members to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery

What We’re Looking For

  • 1–2 years of experience in recruiting, HR, or admin/ops — ideally post-college and in a business setting
  • Excellent written English and comfort communicating with US-based candidates and teams
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail — you keep things moving and nothing falls through the cracks
  • A proactive mindset — you see inefficiencies and suggest better ways to work
  • Comfortable working during US business hours (EST)
  • Bonus: Familiarity with applicant tracking systems or email campaign tools (but not required)

The Details

  • Type: Full-time contract (40 hours/week)
  • Schedule: Must overlap with US business hours (EST)
  • Location: Remote — candidates based in the Philippines are strongly encouraged to apply
  • Growth: Opportunity to grow with the team and take on more responsibility over time

Why Join Us?

You’ll be part of a mission-driven company reshaping how small businesses hire — combining smart humans and GenAI to make recruiting better, faster, and more affordable. You’ll get hands-on experience in a startup environment and have a real voice in how we scale.

raw.title: Transmission Line Project Engineer (Rocky Mountain)- Remote
raw.excerpt: WSP is seeking a Transmission Line Project Engineer to join our Power Delivery Team.
raw.description:
WSP is seeking a Transmission Line Project Engineer to join our Power Delivery Team. This position offers a flexible work arrangements, with the option to work remotely or from one of our offices across the Rocky Mountain region. Preferred locations include:

  • Denver, CO

  • Salt Lake City, UT

  • Billings, MT

  • Bozeman, MT

  • Boise, ID

  • Hailey, ID

Join a growing organization where you will contribute to impactful projects, support our clients’ goals, and help solve complex engineering challenges.

This Opportunity
Provides technical leadership and guidance for the planning, design, and delivery of high‑voltage overhead transmission line projects. Tasks may include research, design, concept development, planning, client interactions, business and proposal development, construction support, and staff mentorship. Supports project development through disciplined engineering practices, coordination across multidisciplinary teams, and adherence to established quality and safety standards. Ensures responsibilities are executed with a level of technical excellence, clarity, and functional performance that meets or exceeds industry expectations.

Your Impact
The successful candidate will be able to lead, support, and coordinate the following:

Project Engineering Leadership

  • Lead and execute the engineering of transmission projects up to 765kV.
  • Lead and/or support the initial project execution layout to ensure an efficient and effective project plan has been established.
  • Responsible for creating and maintaining a project schedule.
  • Conduct weekly or bi-weekly project meetings to outline upcoming deliverables and tasks with the responsible personnel identified clearly.
  • Coordinate with clients on project status and support project meetings as necessary.
  • Maintain project workflow and thorough communication across multi-disciplinary projects, both internal and external to WSP.
  • Forecast upcoming project requirements to assist in resource planning.
  • Facilitate and adhere to WSP’s QA/QC procedures.
  • Participate in industry conferences, both internal and external, to improve professional growth while fostering knowledge transfer to colleagues.
  • Demonstrate transmission line design expertise pertaining to PLS-CADD, structure staking, foundations, assembly drawings, structure loading, material procurement, construction specifications, construction methods, construction estimates, and construction support.
  • Lead project teams of varying sizes.
  • Travel to client offices/field/vendor facilities, as needed.

 Project Manager (PM) Support

  • Support the Project Manager with project status reports.
  • Work with PMs to develop scope, schedule, and budget for new projects.
  • Work with PMs to identify out-of-scope items and support work scope variances.
  • Provide weekly or bi-weekly project updates and project forecasting.
  • Lead and/or support the PM with meetings with clients, both in person and remotely.
  • Develop client relationships, allowing WSP the opportunity to position ourselves to win future work.

Department Support

  • Support resource forecasting.
  • Support recruitment efforts.
  • Provide business improvement methodologies and procedures.
  • Support staff performance and technical development with department leadership.
  • Contribute to the business planning efforts.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering
  • 7-10 years’ experience in the transmission field of designing/managing projects and leading multi-disciplinary teams
  • Professional Engineering (PE) licensure.
  • Understanding of the NESC, RUS, and/or GO-95.
  • Strong understanding of transmission line fundamentals and PLS-CADD operation
  • The candidate must have a strong command of the English language with good written and oral communication skills to work effectively with internal team members and external client personnel.
  • Experience using the Microsoft Office software suite
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Field program planning, management, and execution.
  • Subcontractor management.
  • Cost estimating and scheduling.
  • Field experience.
  • MBA degree from an accredited university.
  • Involvement in technical societies (IEEE, CIGRE, ASCE…)
  • Experience using ArcGIS, AutoCAD/MicroStation, Foundation Design Software (FAD Tools, SHAFT, LPILE).
  • POLE and TOWER experience.

Compensation:
Expected Salary (Colorado only): $115,000 - $195,00

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

Job Title: Business Consultant - Commercial Content

Job Location: Barcelona, Spain

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and Business Consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.
Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Veeva Business Consulting was launched in 2019 and has grown quickly and organically to a global organization of over 400 people. Our team is focused on making the life sciences industry more efficient and effective through software, data, and consulting working together.
We expect significant growth in Business Consulting as we look towards 2030, and are looking for great people to make it happen.

The Role

As a Consultant in our Global Content Practice, you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they work with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value.
You will have the opportunity to shape new ways of working in the end-to-end content operating model – from incorporating AI into a tier-based MLR process, to refining content creation strategy through Claims and Modular Content. These processes and tools help customers get personalized, impactful content to market faster, allowing them to quickly communicate important information to HCPs and patients.

What You'll Do

    • Lead project workstreams from end-to-end, ensuring the high-quality design and delivery of customer solutions
    • Solve complex problems for Life Sciences leaders, leveraging Veeva’s unique data and software insights
    • Mentor and manage Associate Consultants, overseeing their work and professional development within your workstream
    • Drive practice growth by contributing to business development and internal IP creation

Requirements

    • Experience: 3+ years in Life Sciences Consulting (Business or Management Consulting preferred)
    • Domain Knowledge: Proven expertise in Content Operating Models, Med/Legal/Reg Review, and Content Strategy
    • Analytical Rigor: A strong mindset for both quantitative and qualitative reasoning
    • Communication: Ability to articulate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders
    • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher
    • Not a perfect match yet? If you have 3–5 years of life sciences experience, a recent advanced degree, or a military background, Master Class is your pathway to a consulting career. [Explore Master Class]

Nice to Have

    • Knowledge of Veeva products
    • Experience delivering SaaS or Tech-enabled consulting solutions

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Compensation: Highly competitive salary and equity in Veeva
    • Growth: Unrivalled career progression in a fast-growing, global team
    • Flexibility: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 49,000 - 80,000 EUR
    • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

raw.description:
About Versapay 🚀

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.
Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.
Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!
Are you passionate about bridging the gap between technology and business? As a Solutions Engineer at Versapay, you will play a pivotal role in showcasing the value of our innovative financial technology solutions to prospective customers. Your mission will be to build trust in our technology, address client challenges, and remove any technical barriers during the sales
process.

This is a unique opportunity to join a leader in the Financial Technology space, specializing in Invoice Presentment, Payments, Accounts Receivable, Collections, and Cash Application. We’re looking for a dynamic individual who thrives in a client-facing role, understands the fintech industry, and can simplify complex technology to drive business value.

What You'll Do:

  • Engage with customers: Conduct detailed discovery sessions to understand customer
    needs, uncover industry challenges, and identify value-added opportunities for their
    processes.
  • Solution design and demonstration: Build, customize, and showcase innovative
    solutions using Versapay’s application suite and related partner technologies.
  • Be a trusted advisor: Partner with customers and prospects to align their business
    requirements with Versapay’s technology capabilities, articulating how our solutions
    solve key pain points.
  • Support sales cycles: Provide technical expertise during RFIs/RFPs, propose tailored
    configurations and integrations, and address objections confidently.
  • Stay ahead of the curve: Continuously enhance your knowledge through product, sales,
    and technical training. Maintain certifications and leverage your expertise to excel in a
    fast-paced, team-oriented sales environment.
  • Drive results: Collaborate with management to set and achieve quarterly and annual
    goals, contributing to overall business success.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with product, sales, and customer success
    teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
  • Travel: Occasional travel across the US and Canada to engage with clients and partners,
    exhibit at conferences, and build strong relationships.

What We're Looking For:

  • Education & Experience:

About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Job ID: 1883

  • Establish a culture of commercial accountability, cross-functional alignment, and measurable marketing impact

  • Lead integrated campaigns across events, ABM, digital engagement, executive briefings, PR and partner initiatives
  • Support complex enterprise sales cycles with executive-level engagement programs, customer storytelling, and strategic industry initiatives
  • Develop programs that deepen relationships with strategic customers, partners, and ecosystem stakeholders
