Why North Memorial Health?

At North Memorial Health, you’re part of an inclusive health team that is rooted in our values: Advocate Courageously, Rally Together, Respect Uniqueness and Create Impact. Empathy and care are at the heart of North’s culture which is designed to actively support each team member’s wellbeing and growth. Our strength lies in our diversity, and we embrace the unique contributions and experiences of each person. Together, we empower patients to achieve their best health.

Our health system encompasses two hospital locations in Robbinsdale and Maple Grove as well as a network of 23 clinics which includes 13 primary clinics, 6 specialty clinics, 4 urgent care/urgency centers and emergency care offerings covering five counties. Our Robbinsdale Hospital, established in 1954, is a 385-bed facility recognized as the top Level 1 Trauma center for 25 years, as well as serving as a Level II pediatric trauma center. Our Maple Grove Hospital was established in 2009, is a 134-bed facility recognized as a top hospital in the state for Women and Children Care, with a Level III NICU, and is the largest Family Birth Center in the state (~5,000 deliveries per year and over 60,000 babies delivered). Both have been named to the 2022 Fortune/Merative 100 Top Hospitals® list, 2023 Women’s Choice Award Best Hospitals list.

Benefits the North Way!

As North Memorial Health is a non-profit organization you are eligible for the Public Student Loan Forgiveness program. Most part-time and all full-time positions are eligible for benefits.

  • Health & Welfare Benefit Packages
  • 401k Retirement Match or Pension Plan, based on workgroup eligibility
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) Plans
  • Adoption Reimbursement up to $3000 per child
  • Child Care Discount Program with New Horizon 10% off weekly childcare tuition

Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At North Memorial Health we recognize that the strength of our team lies in our diversity and make every effort to embrace the unique contributions and experiences of each person on our team. We strive to ensure that everyone feels like they are a valuable part of our community, with initiatives that reinforce our belief in diversity, equity, and inclusivity, to promote a workforce that enables authenticity, as we want to be our best when providing effective services to our patients. We acknowledge and celebrate the unique traditions, backgrounds, languages, beliefs, and customs of our community, and want everyone to feel welcome. Through our DE&I initiatives we hope to dispel myths, assumptions, and acts of implicit bias.

About this position

The Care Access Nurse Line Nurse uses the nursing process in coordinating all aspects of care for patients. The Nurse applies telephonic communication with and/or regarding an established patient or non-North Memorial established patient in which the Nurse utilzes medically approved nursing protocols to determine urgency of the customer's needs, and appropriate level of care; clinical judgement; and clinical care coordination.The Nurse works towards providing clinical support and coordination to all North Memorial Health Programs. The Nurse maximizes the customer's health outcomes by utilizing standard protocols in triaging, coordinating, and communicating patient care needs. The Nurse executes the Standards of Nursing Practice including: assessment; nursing diagnosis; outcome identification; planning, implementation; and evaluation.The Nurse will provide education, advice, and facilitate communication between patients and North Memorial Health providers, clinics, and departments. At all times, the Nurse helps to foster a team-based, supportive, and collaborative care and work environment, including documenting within the electronic medical record. The scope of practice includes the care of neonates, infants, pediatrics young adults, and older adults throughout the life cycle.

  • Escalate staffing, performance, system, policy, or operational risks to the Program Director with recommended corrective actions.

Claims Processing and Technical Oversight
  • Provide supervisory and technical oversight for end-to-end healthcare claims intake, review, adjudication, payment, denial or rejection, adjustment, and escalation processes.
  • Serve as an operational subject matter expert for complex claims, claim edits, exceptions, reimbursement questions, and processing issues.
  • Ensure consistent interpretation and application of program requirements, benefit rules, covered conditions, reimbursement guidance, and claims processing procedures.
  • Review and help resolve complex or escalated claims issues using applicable policies, procedures, system information, and supporting documentation.
  • Partner with program leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to address recurring claim issues and improve processing consistency.
Coordination of Benefits
  • Oversee coordination of benefits processing, including primary and secondary payer determination, Medicare coordination, Other Health Insurance (OHI), workers compensation coordination, and related recovery activities.
  • Ensure COB claims are processed in accordance with program rules, payer order requirements, available remittance information, and established procedures.
  • Provide guidance on complex COB scenarios, payment calculations, duplicate coverage, liability considerations, and claims requiring additional information.
  • Identify COB-related trends, errors, and training needs, and recommend procedural or system improvements.
New Program Implementation and Operational Readiness
  • Support the design, implementation, and startup of new healthcare claims operations and major program changes.
  • Participate in business requirements reviews, workflow design, claims scenario development, user acceptance testing, defect triage, operational readiness reviews, and go-live support.
  • Help establish staffing plans, work assignments, escalation paths, quality controls, productivity expectations, and standard operating procedures for new operations.
  • Validate that claims workflows and system configurations support program requirements, business rules, benefit limitations, COB requirements, and operational expectations.
  • Identify implementation gaps, dependencies, and risks and communicate recommended solutions to the Program Director.
PLEXIS System and Workflow Support
  • Use the PLEXIS claims system, or comparable claims administration technology, to support daily claims operations, queue management, issue research, and staff guidance.
  • Assist with system workflow validation, claims testing, edit review, defect documentation, and confirmation that approved fixes operate as intended.
  • Coordinate with technical and operational stakeholders to resolve system issues affecting claims processing, COB, quality, or productivity.
  • Document system workarounds, known issues, and processing guidance until permanent solutions are implemented.
Quality, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement
  • Conduct or oversee claims quality reviews, calibration sessions, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and focused retraining.
  • Monitor operational trends, error patterns, inventory, aging, and recurring issues to identify opportunities for process, training, staffing, or system improvement.
  • Promote compliance with contract requirements, privacy and security obligations, J29 policies, and program-specific procedures.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and support operational reporting requested by the Program Director.
  • Promote a collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement culture within a fully remote team.
Experience:
  • 8+ years of healthcare claims processing, adjudication, reimbursement, payment integrity, claims review, or related healthcare claims operations experience.
  • 3+ years of experience supervising or formally leading claims processors, examiners, analysts, or comparable healthcare operations staff.
  • Demonstrated experience managing team productivity, quality, workload distribution, coaching, accountability, and operational performance.
  • Strong working knowledge of the end-to-end healthcare claims lifecycle, including intake, review, adjudication, reimbursement, adjustments, denials or rejections, and escalation handling.
  • Demonstrated experience with coordination of benefits, including primary and secondary payer rules, Medicare coordination, Other Health Insurance (OHI), workers compensation coordination, and recovery processes.
  • Experience supporting new program implementations, operational startups, claims system implementations or upgrades, process redesign, operational readiness, user acceptance testing, and go-live activities.
  • Experience developing, implementing, or maintaining claims processing SOPs, workflows, desk procedures, job aids, quality controls, and training materials.
  • Ability to analyze complex claims and operational issues, interpret requirements, document decisions, and communicate clear direction to staff and stakeholders.
  • Strong independent problem-solving, organization, leadership, and time management skills in a fully remote environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and other collaboration or reporting tools.
Preferred Experience:
  • Hands-on experience with the PLEXIS claims system, including claims processing, workflow navigation, issue research, testing, or operational support.
  • Experience supporting a limited health benefit, specialty benefit, occupational health, workers compensation, Federal healthcare, or other program in which coverage is tied to defined eligibility and covered conditions.
  • Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, Federal healthcare, or third-party administrator claims operations.
  • Experience with benefit configuration, provider reimbursement, appeals, payment integrity, prior authorization, claims quality, or auditing.
  • Knowledge of healthcare electronic transactions and files, including 834, 835, and 837 transactions, and a general understanding of file transfer processes.
  • Experience with PLEXIS and one or more additional claims payment, adjudication, workflow, or case management systems, such as Facets, QNXT, HealthRules, NASCO, or TriZetto platforms.
  • Working knowledge of medical coding, including ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, revenue codes, modifiers, and the effect of coding on claim payment and authorization decisions.
  • Experience with claims reporting, operational dashboards, service-level agreement tracking, root cause analysis, SQL, Power BI, or comparable reporting tools.
  • Healthcare claims, coding, billing, auditing, health information management, or related industry certification.
Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, public policy, or a related field is required. Relevant additional experience may be considered in accordance with company requirements.
  • Claims-related certifications or training are preferred.

Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As our Senior User Acquisition Manager, you'll own one of our largest paid channels end to end — strategy, budget allocation, creative direction and funnel performance. This is a high-ticket product with a long, partly offline sales cycle: the sale doesn't happen in the ad account, it happens weeks later on a call with our sales team. Your job is to understand that whole path and move it.

This is a hands-on, single-owner role: no layer of buyers between you and the account. Reporting to our Marketing Lead, you'll work directly with creative, sales and analytics.

What you will do

  • Own the channel, not the tasks: Strategy, campaign structure, budget allocation and results are yours. You keep the account impeccable — nothing runs that shouldn't — and you defend your numbers to the business.
  • Run a continuous flow of tests across audiences, funnels and creatives. Each launch starts with a written plan — hypothesis, metric, budget, decision rule.
  • Read the whole funnel: CPL and lead volume are the beginning of the story, not the end. You track lead → SQL → sale.

Requirements

  • UA Expertise: 3+ years in User Acquisition, including personal ownership of Meta accounts at $50k+/month. Ownership means you set the strategy.
  • Relevant Recent Experience: In the last 2–3 years, products with a considered purchase and a long or offline conversion — education, B2B, fintech, real estate, healthcare or similar.
  • Analytical Rigor: Comfortable well past the ad account — lead quality, CAC, ROI, and reporting you build for yourself. You can name a change of yours that moved a down-funnel metric, and explain how you knew it worked.
  • Structured Thinking on Paper: Launch plans, test maps and post-mortems are a habit.
  • A Position You Can Defend: You've seen a problem nobody assigned to you, dug into the data, proposed a solution and carried it through. You argue with your manager when you think they're wrong — with evidence.
  • Creative Intuition: While you don't need to be a designer, you must have a deep understanding of visual hooks, messaging, and what drives engagement in the current Meta landscape.
  • Adaptability: A fast-paced, remote-first environment where you work independently and own your results.
  • Language Proficiency: Working proficiency in English (B2+ preferred).

What we can offer you

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Full-time remote contract with a flexible schedule.
  • A close-knit, international team of thoughtful and driven professionals.
  • All software licenses and remote work tools you need to be successful in a remote working environment (Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc).

The role involves building scalable APIs, designing DynamoDB data models, developing Python-based Lambda functions, and managing infrastructure using Terraform. The ideal candidate will possess strong AWS development expertise, hands-on Amazon Connect experience, and the ability to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance cloud solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams and Amazon Professional Services.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs to support frontend applications and enterprise integrations.
  • Design and optimize DynamoDB schemas, indexes, and data access patterns for scalable applications.
  • Develop and maintain Python-based AWS Lambda functions for business logic and automation.
  • Modify, enhance, and maintain Amazon Connect contact flows and routing logic.
  • Collaborate with UI development teams to translate business requirements into backend services and APIs.
  • Work directly with Amazon Professional Services on Amazon Connect implementation and enhancement initiatives.
  • Design and support event-driven architectures using AWS services such as Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, and API Gateway.
  • Support and optimize data flows across AWS services and integrated systems.
  • Implement secure, scalable, and highly available cloud-native solutions.
  • Troubleshoot application, integration, and infrastructure issues across AWS environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure reliable and efficient service delivery.
  • Participate in production support activities and occasional after-hours deployments when required.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience with AWS.
  • 4+ years of experience with Amazon Connect, including contact flows, routing, queues, and integrations.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, including development of AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, IAM, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, and CloudWatch.
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and backend integrations.
  • Strong knowledge of DynamoDB schema design, indexing strategies, and performance optimization.
  • Experience designing and supporting cloud-native and event-driven architectures.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation practices.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering and business teams.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
  • Experience converting AWS CDK or CloudFormation templates into Terraform.
  • Experience with IBM ODM

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a valuesdriven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.

  • Desenvolver soluções seguindo princípios de Security by Design, observando requisitos de segurança, privacidade e desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial Generativa para aumentar a produtividade nas atividades de desenvolvimento, análise, documentação e engenharia de software, respeitando as diretrizes de segurança, governança e uso responsável estabelecidas pela Shift.

Processos

  • Contribuir para a evolução da base de conhecimento, padrões de desenvolvimento, checklists técnicos, documentação e boas práticas da organização;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa, promovendo uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo, inovação, compartilhamento de conhecimento e melhoria constante dos produtos e processos da Shift.
    • Graduação completa em áreas de Tecnologia da Informação;

    • Experiência com desenvolvimento Front-end utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript e Angular 16+;
    • Experiência com desenvolvimento Back-end utilizando Java, APIs REST e SQL;
    • Conhecimento em modelagem de banco de dados relacionais;

    • Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando Git;
    • Conhecimento em princípios de orientação a objetos, boas práticas de desenvolvimento, Clean Code e design de APIs;

Informações adicionais

Benefícios

Opportunity

ThermalWorks has an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about sustainability and eager to be part of an innovative company that’s on a journey to transform the world’s infrastructure.

We are seeking an R&D Engineer to join the R&D team, to design, prototype, test, and validate new cooling products and product improvements - from concept through handoff to manufacturing. You will work hands-on with refrigeration circuits, hydronics, and controls, and will turn test data into design decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Include but are not limited to:

  • Design and develop new cooling products and improvements to existing platforms — chillers, CDUs, and supporting systems
    • Plan and execute validation and performance testing; analyze results and drive design changes from the data
    • Build and iterate prototypes, working hands-on in the lab and test environment
    • Perform thermal, refrigeration, and hydronic system calculations and component selection
    • Support the transition of new designs from R&D to manufacturing, resolving design-for-manufacturability issues
    • Document designs, test procedures, and results to engineering standards
    • Incorporate field and application feedback into product improvements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field
    • 5+ years of engineering experience in refrigeration, HVAC, or cooling product development
    • Hands-on experience with prototype builds and lab testing of thermal systems
    • Strong grasp of refrigeration cycles, heat transfer, and hydronic system design
    • Ability to analyze test data and translate results into design decisions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing chillers, CDUs, or liquid cooling for data center applications
    • Familiarity with controls development and system instrumentation
    • Advanced degree in Mechanical or Thermal EngineeringWorking at Endeavour

Innovate at Speed: Thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas actually matter.
Own Your Work: Enjoy the flexibility and autonomy to execute and do your best work.
Learn from the Best: Collaborate daily with top-tier, experienced industry experts.
Elevate Your Craft: Be part of a respectful, continuous-learning culture driven by excellence.
Make a Real Impact: Join a team of dedicated changemakers building solutions that benefit people and the planet.

About ThermalWorks

ThermalWorks transforms data center cooling with ultra-efficient, modular systems that support dynamic AI workloads in any climate, with zero water consumption. Its multi-function chillers unify dry, trim, and full mechanical cooling into a single adaptive platform engineered to maximize tokens per watt.

About Endeavour

Endeavour builds technology infrastructure for the benefit of all. As the AI revolution drives unprecedented demand for resources, Endeavour provides the integrated infrastructure required to support global innovation while restoring the local environments we serve.

Inspired by nature, we design infrastructure as a cohesive system where every element feeds another to create a cycle of regeneration. This vision is realized through the Endeavour Stack, a collection of next-generation technologies that solve critical challenges in data, energy, materials, and water. Director of Development (Volunteer)

Mothers to Daughters

About Mothers to Daughters:

Mothers to Daughters (M2D) is a 501(c)(3) non-profit dedicated to empowering women across generations through leadership and entrepreneurship training, educational workshops, and networking opportunities. Through intergenerational mentorship and community service, M2D advances gender equality, fosters leadership, and equips women to drive social and economic change in their communities. This handbook outlines our values, policies, and operational procedures to guide team members in fulfilling our mission.

Our Mission at Mothers to Daughters is to accelerate the personal and professional growth of women by connecting them with the lived experiences, authentic insights, and transformative wisdom of successful women. Through intergenerational mentorship, we foster a legacy of economic empowerment, social resilience, and impact-driven innovation, equipping women to lead, innovate, and build sustainable solutions that transcend generations.

Our Vision is a world where women of all generations thrive through the power of intergenerational wisdom, driving inclusivity and gender equity for lasting global impact. By bridging generations, amplifying voices, and breaking down barriers, we aim to create a future where women are elevated to the heights they deserve—leading, innovating, and shaping a more equitable and prosperous world for all.

Our Core Values at Mothers to Daughters are:

  • UnwaveringRespect

    • We honor diverse perspectives and experiences, fostering an environment where every voice is valued.

    • We believe in mutual respect between generations, recognizing the wisdom of experience and the disruptive innovation of youth.

    • We encourage bold yet respectful dialogue in discussions around gender equality, relationships, and personal development.

  • Purpose driven-Trust

    • We prioritize transparency, accountability, and credibility, ensuring that our members, mentors, and sponsors feel confident in our work.

    • We believe trust is the cornerstone of meaningful mentorship, enabling honest, courageous conversations and impactful guidance.

    • We commit to upholding the integrity of our mission, maintaining the highest ethical standards in all our partnerships and programs.

  • Synergistic Collaboration

    • We recognize that transformative change happens when we work together across generations, cultures, and industries.

    • We actively forge alliances with organizations that align with our mission, including men’s groups working toward gender equity.

    • We foster a culture of dynamic knowledge-sharing, ensuring that mentorship is a two-way exchange where both mentors and mentees grow together.

  • Transformational Empathy

    • We understand that each woman’s journey is unique, committing to creating a safe space for shared experiences and personal growth.

    • We recognize societal and personal challenges women face and approach solutions with compassion and pragmatic action.

    • We champion vulnerability as a strength, encouraging open discussions about both breakthroughs and setbacks.

  • Impact-Driven Entrepreneurial Spirit

    • We believe in equipping women with the skills, mindset, and resources to take ownership of their futures—whether through career advancement, leadership, or business ventures.

    • We encourage innovation, agility, and adaptability, ensuring our programs evolve to meet the shifting needs of our global community.

    • We emphasize bold resilience, helping women break barriers, embrace risk, and lead with confidence.

  • Unapologetic Authenticity

    • We embrace and celebrate individuality, encouraging women to bring their whole selves to the table.

    • We champion unapologetic self-expression, ensuring that every woman’s voice is heard, respected, and amplified.

    • We commit to honest, transparent communication, rejecting performative feminism in favor of practical, high-impact actions that drive real change.

  • Future-focused Innovation

    • We embrace bold, transformative thinking, pushing boundaries to create solutions that redefine possibilities for women.

    • We leverage technology, data, and creativity to amplify mentorship, leadership, and economic empowerment initiatives.

    • We foster a culture of continuous learning and reinvention, ensuring that women stay ahead in an ever-evolving global landscape.

Position Overview:

The Director of Development will develop and execute M2D’s fundraising strategy to secure sustainable funding that fuels our mentorship and leadership programs, as well as organizational growth. This role will set annual fundraising goals, cultivate donor and partner relationships, lead grant writing, oversee fundraising events, and manage development operations, including donor stewardship, database management, and impact reporting. The Director will also represent M2D externally and collaborate with internal teams to advance fundraising efforts. As part of our dynamic and mission-driven team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our organization and advancing our mission.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Fundraising

  • Develop and execute comprehensive fundraising strategy

  • Set and achieve annual fundraising goals

  • Create compelling grant proposals and reports

  • Manage donor relationships and stewardship programs

  • Organize fundraising events and campaigns

Development Operations

  • Oversee donor database management

  • Track and analyze fundraising metrics

  • Manage development budget

  • Coordinate with program teams for impact reporting

  • Supervise development staff and volunteers

External Relations

  • Build relationships with foundations and corporate donors

  • Represent M2D at networking events

  • Collaborate with marketing team on donor communications

  • Develop fundraising materials and presentations

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 7+ years nonprofit fundraising experience

  • Proven success in major gifts and grant acquisition

  • Experience with donor management systems

  • Strong writing and presentation skills

  • Bachelor's degree required

  • Deep understanding of women's empowerment initiatives

Commitment:

  • Serve at the organization for 1 year.

  • Ability to meet and collaborate weekly via Zoom, Google Drive, Microsoft and Slack with the team.

  • Ability to attend monthly Team All Hands via Zoom.

  • Approximate time commitment: 10-15 hours monthly

Benefits:

  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in empowering the next generation of women leaders.

  • Enhance the impact of our programs on women's economic advancement, intellectual growth, and social mobility.

  • Access to our network of elite professionals (business executives, entrepreneurs, community leaders etc) and professional development opportunities through board service.

How to Apply:

Interested candidates should fill out the application form and submit their resume and cover letter.

Mothers to Daughters is an equal opportunity organization and encourages applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

raw.description:
Position Summary

To advance Teach For All’s 25-year vision, we are seeking a strategic AI leader developer to join our Technology & Innovation team and work globally to identify and implement transformative technology solutions to accelerate the impact of our global network.

This role will work across the network with partners or groups of partners in order to identify and deliver transformative AI-forward technology products to accelerate network impact, as well as internally across the global organization to increase efficiency and effectiveness of our work. The successful candidate will also be responsible for helping build and cultivate a community of technology enthusiasts across the network made up of network staff members, fellows and alumni who will contribute to these projects.

About the Team

The Technology & Innovation Team provides thought-leadership and solutions as well as foundational support in the use of technology to unlock potential and accelerate impact across the organization and the global network. The team leverages a deep understanding of the work and needs of the global organization, its teams and partners, our own expertise and global best practice to provide targeted solutions and technologies to accelerate our global impact. You will play a key role in this work.

Outcomes

  • Identifying and delivering key AI-forward technologies for network partners to support their work. These may include tools for common needs across the network – classroom data collection, professional development of fellows, scheduling and management of Assessment Centers (where teaching fellows are selected) or new platforms (connectivity tools, online learning) - which are identified and scoped in partnership with our network partners. Many if not all of these technologies will include AI components.
  • Similarly, identifying and delivering technology solutions to increase the impact of the global organization. This could include improvements to ourlearning portals for network staff, fellows and alumni, an online platform enabling teachers and teacher coaches across and beyond our network to engage in our global professional development learning community, or a new global “constituent voice” system that enables all our network partners to surface feedback from key constituents in ways that strengthen global learning loops.
  • Taking an AI-forward approach to increase organizational effectiveness, increase our impact in supporting network partners in their work, and evolve our systems and ways of working to incorporate new tools and technologies.
  • Successful management of two solutions engineers and a UI/UX specialist to deliver your ambitious strategy and goals.

Key Responsibilities :

Strategy Development

  • Working across network partners and internal stakeholders including our AI and Ed Tech Initiative team to build context and identify key potential technology solutions to accelerate impact
  • Developing a responsive and evolving strategy to prioritize and develop these key technologies, working closely with the Technology & Innovation team and key senior stakeholders to invest them in the strategy
  • Providing regular updates internally and externally regarding progress, and regularly revisiting and modifying the solutions strategy as needs change

Requirements Gathering, Analysis and Execution

  • Gathering requirements for prioritized projects through stakeholder interviews and discussion, ensuring that all projects are accessible, inclusive of the various needs of the network and sustainable for all network partners
  • Synthesizing requirements and developing holistic solutions to meet the needs of your stakeholders, ensuring that key needs and requirements are met within project and budgetary constraints
  • Working both individually and collaboratively across the Technology & Innovation team and any external vendors or collaborators needed to develop and deliver prioritized solutions
  • Ensuring that end users are trained and supported along with the Technology & Innovation Operations team
  • Identifying key metrics and measures of success, and reporting on those throughout the phases of each project
  • Identifying and managing key improvements through user and stakeholder interviews

Team Management

  • Lead a team of 2 within the broader Technology & Innovation team to deliver on your solutions strategy for the organization and broader network

Community Building and Management

  • Supplementing the work of the AI and Ed Tech Initiative team, helping develop a community of technology enthusiasts across the network, and working across key stakeholders internally and throughout the network to share best practice and amplify the impact of community members
  • Where possible, involving the community members in the development of the technology solutions identified as part of the three year strategy
  • Encouraging and supporting community-developed solutions

Qualifications

  • Computer Science or related degree and/or equivalent years of formal training and experience, with a clear track record of delivering AI-forward solutions in a broad range of contexts
  • 7+ years of relevant working experience, including designing and delivering AI-powered solutions, with a proven portfolio showcasing high-impact, scalable implementations across diverse contexts
  • Strong experience with AI libraries and frameworks, as well as associated Typescript and Python skills
  • REST-based API integration experience, preferably including experience with popular Generative AI APIs and libraries
  • Proficiency in Git and other version control systems is essential, with a proven ability to effectively manage code repositories, track changes, and collaborate with team members using branching, merging, and pull request workflows.
  • Ability to design easy to use and compelling user interfaces and experiences
  • Experience with Cloud Technologies, including Google Cloud
  • Comfort and experience in engaging with new technologies
  • Participation in open-source development projects and communities
  • An understanding of working with technology in bandwidth-constrained environments
  • Passion about Education, AI and Ed Tech
  • History of driving technology projects from inception to delivery
  • Strong business analyst skills, communications skills and ability to manage multiple diverse stakeholders
  • Sensitivity to diversity in backgrounds and beliefs (e.g., racial, cultural, socioeconomic, political, etc.)
  • Deeply committed to the mission, vision and values of Teach For All

Additional desirable skills/experiences

  • Comfort and curiosity in engaging with new and emerging technologies
  • Participation in open-source development projects and communities
  • Experience working in bandwidth-constrained environments
  • Passion for Education, AI and EdTech
  • Proven track record of driving technology projects from inception to delivery
  • Sensitivity to diversity in backgrounds and beliefs (e.g., racial, cultural, socioeconomic, political, etc.)
  • Strong alignment with and commitment to the mission, vision, and values of Teach For All

What Teach For All Offers:

  • Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization’s progress
  • Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
  • Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
  • All roles are 100% remote; in some locations we offer the option for in-office collaborations
  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements
  • And much more!

Compensation

This role is a three-year fixed term contract. Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

Work Authorization

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.

Travel and Hours

Travel up to 20% is possible when it is safe to do so and in accordance with local travel guidelines. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role. This role will communicate and work globally regardless of location.

Apply now

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all

About Teach For All

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations’ under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All’s global organization works to increase the network’s impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

Experience in technical writing within the AI, enterprise infrastructure, or enterprise IT highly desired.

Company Description

Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well. Our mission is to empower people to live more enriched lives by delivering a new standard of advice. By removing asset minimums, we provide holistic planning that goes far beyond investments to address every way money impacts life. Our team of CFP® professionals are at the core of our service and are empowered by our best-in-class support teams and proprietary technology platform. This model allows Facet to integrate advice into our members’ entire financial picture—all for an affordable, flat membership fee.

Our commitment to innovation and member success has earned national recognition, including being ranked the #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY and named to Newsweek’s list of America’s Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. With an A+ BBB Rating and a Trustpilot “Excellent” score (as of Sept. 16, 2025)*, we are proud to be redefining the industry for our members and our team alike.

About the Role

This is a leadership role built for an experienced CFP® leader who wants to stay connected to members while driving company-wide impact. This person will direct a high-performing pod of financial planners, serve as the internal subject matter expert for a key practice area, and partner directly with the Product, Marketing, and Compliance teams. They will also maintain a small, select member practice of 25–35 members to pilot new ideas and model best practices for their team.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

  • Guide a dedicated team of CFP® professionals, coaching them on both technical mastery and the human side of financial planning—helping them build deep trust and deliver clear, actionable advice.
  • Serve as the internal lead and authority on a specific planning domain, turning your team's expertise into scalable frameworks, teaching tools, and firm-wide best practices.
  • Serve as the lead Planning representative in cross-functional discussions with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Compliance to ensure our tools and client communications match actual planning realities.
  • Manage a small book of 25–35 client relationships (~15% of time) to test new practice initiatives, run live demonstration sessions, and keep an understanding of the member experience.

What We’re Looking For

  • CFP® designation required.
  • 10+ years of comprehensive financial planning experience, along with 5+ years of direct leadership experience guiding high-performing planning teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn complex planning concepts into simple, practical frameworks that scale across an organization.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven track record of resolving complex organizational challenges constructively and diplomatically.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + bonus determined by the experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant.
  • Equity (ISOs): it is important to us that all employees are shareholders in our mission.
  • Flexible PTO
  • All the benefits: medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with employer match, short and long term disability coverage (paid by Facet), life insurance options, and paid parental leave.
  • Certification reimbursement program.
  • Work from anywhere in the US.

*Facet was ranked #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY in April 2025 who partnered with Statista to rank the top 500 RIAs. Recommendations were collected via an independent survey among over 30,000 individuals. self-recommendations were prohibited, and no compensation was provided for the ranking. Facet has been Accredited with the Better Business Bureau® since June 2025, and as of February 2026 holds an A+ BBB Rating. This Accreditation does not imply BBB approval or endorsement. Plant-A Insights Group and Newsweek partnered to identify America's Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. This analysis was performed with data as of September 2024 and reviewed over 15,000 financial advisories registered with the SEC. These rankings prepared by Plant-A reflect editorial content and no compensation was provided by Facet in connection with America's Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. As of February 25, 2026; Facet has a 4.8 star rating with TrustPilot.com. TrustPilot uses a formula for calculation that considers three factors: time span, frequency, and Bayesian average. After the calculation, a TrustScore is then visualized into a star rating from 1 to 5 stars, including half stars. Facet’s star rating is calculated from reviews from January of 2022 to present day. Daily star rating may fluctuate. Companies on Trustpilot aren't allowed to offer incentives or pay to hide reviews and Facet has not made any payments in offer or receipt of any reviews.

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Fleet Administrative Assistant

Compensation range: $1,500 to $1,800 AUD/Month

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an established Australian property development company with over 25 years of experience across commercial, industrial, and residential projects. With in-house expertise spanning development, civil works, design, and consultancy, the business manages projects from feasibility and approvals through to construction and completion, with a strong focus on efficient delivery, accountability, and quality outcomes.

Role Overview: Our client is seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Remote Fleet and Administration Support professional to support fleet, asset, construction administration, and accounts functions across three related Australian businesses.

The role combines fleet administration with data-entry level support across construction contracts, accounts payable, and accounts receivable. The successful candidate will work with the Machine & Asset Supervisor and senior management to maintain accurate records, identify issues, follow up outstanding items, and ensure day-to-day administrative processes are completed consistently.

Detailed process documents and flowcharts will be provided to guide the role.

Key Responsibilities

Fleet & Asset Administration

  • Maintain accurate fleet and asset records across multiple business entities.
  • Review daily pre-starts, identify missing submissions, and record reported defects or issues.
  • Reconcile fleet card transactions against Fuellox fuel usage and asset records.
  • Investigate unusual or inconsistent fuel transactions and escalate discrepancies.
  • Maintain the asset register, including registrations, locations, operators, status, and maintenance information.
  • Track outstanding repairs, documentation, and fleet-related requirements.
  • Prepare regular fleet reports covering fuel usage, pre-starts, defects, repairs, and items requiring management attention.

Construction & Accounts Administration

  • Enter and update project information in Procore.
  • Review contractor uploads, including site photos and progress claims, for completeness.
  • Follow up missing certificates, documentation, or supporting information.
  • Enter supplier invoices into Xero and Procore with the correct entity, project, cost code, and supplier allocation.
  • Raise purchase orders based on approved purchasing instructions.
  • Match supplier invoices against purchase orders and delivery documentation, checking quantities, pricing, GST, and supporting records.
  • Raise customer invoices based on approved billing information, including staff hours, machinery usage, project charges, and progress claims.
  • Match customer payments and remittance information against outstanding invoices.
  • Identify and escalate invoice, payment, documentation, or allocation discrepancies.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Experience in fleet administration, construction administration, accounts administration, data entry, or a similar role.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy when working across multiple systems and records.
  • Strong Excel and data reconciliation skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organisational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to identify discrepancies and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Comfortable working independently within documented processes.
  • Ability to manage confidential and commercially sensitive business information.
  • Reliable remote working setup with strong internet connectivity.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience in fleet, construction, civil, plant, equipment, or asset administration.
  • Experience with Procore, Fuellox, fleet card systems, Xero, ERP, or asset management systems.
  • Experience reviewing pre-starts, progress claims, supplier invoices, or project documentation.
  • Previous experience supporting Australian businesses.
  • Strong Excel or spreadsheet reporting capability.

What Success Looks Like

  • Fleet and asset records remain accurate, current, and reliable.
  • Daily pre-starts and reported defects are reviewed and appropriately followed up.
  • Fleet card and Fuellox activity is accurately reconciled.
  • Supplier invoices, purchase orders, and customer invoices are entered accurately and correctly allocated.
  • Missing documentation and discrepancies are identified before progressing through workflows.
  • Outstanding issues are consistently followed up and escalated when required.
  • Management receives clear and timely information across fleet, projects, and accounts.

Important

  • This is an administrative support role, not an account-management or approval position. The successful candidate will be responsible for checking, recording, reporting, following up, and escalating issues, but will not approve payments or invoices, make contractual decisions, sign off compliance requirements, or make operational or safety decisions.
  • The role supports GN Tech, MKM Civil, and NK Developments, with records and reporting kept separately by entity.
  • The core principle of the role is:

CHECK → RECORD → REPORT → FOLLOW UP → ESCALATE

This is a long-term opportunity for a reliable and detail-focused professional who can provide accurate fleet information and administrative support to management across multiple Australian businesses.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for an Product Manager to join our New Product Introduction team, focused on nuclear reactor products. We are looking to fill this position immediately.

Position Description

Oklo’s Product Managers are responsible for identifying, defining, developing, and deploying new products that advance the company’s mission. These products may involve new applications of Oklo’s technology, capabilities incorporated into future deployments, or offerings that create additional value for customers and stakeholders.

The Product Manager works across engineering, commercial, operations, licensing, manufacturing, supply chain, and other functions to translate promising ideas into well-defined, deployable products. This role establishes the product vision, identifies customer and business needs, defines requirements and success criteria, and guides the product through technical development and deployment.

This is a highly technical product role. The Product Manager must be able to understand complex engineered systems, work closely with technical teams, and make thoughtful tradeoffs among performance, cost, schedule, risk, manufacturability, licensing, and customer value. Successful candidates may come from a product management background with strong engineering experience or may be engineers who are excited to take broader ownership of product strategy and deployment.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Identifying and evaluating opportunities for products, capabilities, and applications of Oklo nuclear reactor technology.
  • Developing clear product visions, value propositions, business cases, and deployment strategies.
  • Working with customers, partners, commercial teams, and internal stakeholders to understand needs and translate them into actionable product requirements.
  • Partnering closely with engineering teams to define product functionality, technical requirements, interfaces, performance objectives, and acceptance criteria.
  • Building and maintaining product roadmaps that connect technical development with commercial opportunities and deployment objectives.
  • Guiding reactor technology products from early concept and feasibility assessment through design, development, validation, and deployment.
  • Establishing appropriate product development plans, decision points, maturity criteria, and measures of success.
  • Leading cross-functional trade studies and decisions involving technical performance, safety, cost, schedule, licensing, manufacturability, operability, and commercial value.
  • Ensuring development work is appropriately sized and focused on resolving the most important product risks and uncertainties.
  • Coordinating across engineering, licensing, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, operations, finance, and commercial teams to maintain alignment and execution.
  • Identifying reactor technology product risks, dependencies, and critical decisions and ensuring they are clearly owned and resolved.
  • Communicating reactor technology product priorities, technical considerations, decisions, and progress to company leadership and other stakeholders.
  • Supporting design reviews, customer engagements, partner discussions, procurement activities, and deployment planning.
  • Developing a strong understanding of the technical and regulatory environment affecting the product and incorporating relevant constraints into reactor product strategy.
  • Gathering feedback from testing, deployment, operations, customers, and partners to guide continued product improvement.
  • Establishing clear reactor technology product ownership and maintaining accountability for overall product outcomes throughout the product lifecycle.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, engineering, systems engineering, technical program management, or a similar role developing complex technical products.
  • Specific experience with nuclear reactor technology in areas such as design, safety, licensing, construction, or operations.
  • An engineering degree or equivalent experience working directly with engineered systems and technical development teams.
  • Demonstrated experience translating customer, business, or operational needs into product requirements and development priorities.
  • Experience guiding technical work from early-stage concepts toward validated, deployable solutions.
  • Ability to understand complex technical information and make informed tradeoffs involving performance, cost, schedule, risk, and customer value.
  • Experience coordinating work and decisions across multiple technical and non-technical functions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience developing hardware, energy systems, industrial equipment, or other complex physical products.
  • Experience as a practicing engineer or technical lead.
  • Experience with product development in regulated industries such as nuclear energy, aerospace, medical devices, or advanced manufacturing.
  • Experience developing business cases, product roadmaps, technical requirements, or deployment strategies.
  • Experience working with customers, commercial partners, vendors, or government stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with isotope production, nuclear fuel, advanced manufacturing, or related technologies.
  • Experience in a startup or rapidly scaling organization.

Competencies

Technical & Role-Specific Competencies

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to understand complex engineered systems.
  • Ability to connect customer and business needs with feasible technical solutions.
  • Experience defining product requirements, development priorities, success criteria, and product roadmaps.
  • Strong structured problem-solving skills; able to break ambiguous opportunities into clear questions, workstreams, decisions, and deliverables.
  • Ability to evaluate and communicate tradeoffs among technical performance, safety, cost, schedule, licensing, manufacturability, operability, and commercial value.
  • Ability to guide products through multiple stages of maturity, from early opportunity identification and feasibility assessment through development and deployment.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to build alignment without relying on direct authority.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to engineering teams, company leadership, customers, partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Sound judgment regarding when additional analysis is necessary and when a product is sufficiently mature to proceed.
  • Ability to maintain focus on overall product outcomes while engaging deeply enough in technical details to support effective decisions.

Ways You Work

  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities across teams.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communicator.
  • Proactive, low-ego leader who takes ownership and follows through.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and iterating as priorities evolve.
  • Curious and eager to develop a strong understanding of new technologies, markets, and customer needs.
  • Able to move comfortably between product strategy, technical detail, and execution planning.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment.

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $140,000-$200,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

Legence also delivers long-term performance through strategic upgrades and holistic solutions. Serving some of the world’s most technically demanding sectors, Legence counts over 60% of the Nasdaq-100 Index among its clients.

Position Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled Power BI Data Engineer who combines deep technical expertise in data engineering with exceptional data visualization abilities. This hands-on role requires someone who can architect robust data solutions while creating compelling, insight-driven dashboards that transform complex data into clear, actionable intelligence. This role is expected to interact directly with end users regarding requirements, testing, and implementation. This position is remote with preference to align to one of Legence’ s office locations. Key Responsibilities Power BI Development & Visualization

  • Create sophisticated, visually stunning Power BI dashboards and reports that drive business decisions
  • Develop advanced DAX calculations, measures, and calculated columns to support complex analytical requirements
  • Design intuitive, user-friendly interfaces with custom visuals, drill-through capabilities, and interactive features
  • Implement dynamic report features including bookmarks, parameters, field parameters, and dynamic formatting
  • Build composite models and leverage advanced features like aggregations, incremental refresh, and query folding

Data Engineering & Architecture

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Power Query, Dataflows, and Azure Data Factory

Technical Implementation

  • Optimize report performance through query optimization, data model refinement, and DAX tuning
  • Integrate Power BI with various data sources including SQL databases, APIs, SharePoint, Excel, and cloud platforms
  • Automate data refresh schedules and monitor gateway configurations

Required Qualifications Technical Skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI development (Desktop, Service, and Report Server)
  • Expert-level proficiency in DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) and Power Query (M language)
  • Strong SQL skills with experience in database design, query optimization, and performance tuning
  • Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and ETL principles
  • Experience with data visualization best practices and UI/UX design principles
  • Proficiency in Azure data services (Azure SQL Database, Synapse Analytics, Data Factory, or Fabric)

Data & Analytical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of data modeling techniques and relationships (one-to-many, many-to-many, bi-directional)
  • Strong grasp of statistical concepts and analytical methodologies
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical data solutions
  • Experience with data quality assessment and data profiling

Professional Competencies

  • Proven ability to create visually compelling, executive-level dashboards and reports
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach
  • Excellent communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented with commitment to code quality and documentation
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI and automation in software engineering

Preferred Qualifications

  • CS or CIS bachelor 's degree
  • Microsoft certifications: PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-203 (Data Engineer), or DP-500 (Enterprise Data Analyst)
  • Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics integration
  • Familiarity with Git/Azure DevOps for version control and CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of DAX Studio, and other Power BI development tools
  • Experience with Power BI Embedded or custom API development
  • Understanding of data science concepts and predictive analytics

Technical Environment

  • Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, Power BI Premium/Fabric
  • SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, Azure Synapse Analytics
  • Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage
  • DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, Power Query
  • Git/Azure DevOps for version control

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Portfolio of impressive Power BI dashboards demonstrating design excellence and technical complexity
  • Track record of optimizing poorly performing reports and data models
  • Experience mentoring others in Power BI development and best practices
  • Contributions to the Power BI community (blog posts, speaking engagements, open-source projects)

This is a hands-on technical role requiring daily interaction with data, code, and visualization design. The ideal candidate thrives in environments where they can build solutions from the ground up and take ownership of the entire BI development lifecycle. Base salary: $105,000–$120,000 per year. This role may be eligible for participation in discretionary bonus plan based on company and individual performance. Notes: Actual compensation will be based on skills, experience, and work location, and may vary from the posted range. raw.description:
The Opportunity:

Versant's Sports & Entertainment Digital Products division is seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to help drive the reliability, scalability, and usability of internal developer platforms, tooling, and engineering workflows across a portfolio of industry-leading brands including Fandango, Fandango at Home, Rotten Tomatoes, SportsEngine, GolfNow, and GolfPass.

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader within the platform engineering ecosystem, helping shape engineering standards, drive reliability initiatives, and influence the evolution of developer experience capabilities across multiple product teams. You will partner across engineering, platform operations, and security teams to build scalable self-service capabilities, reduce operational friction, and enable teams to deliver software safely and efficiently.

Why This Role Matters:

Developer productivity is a force multiplier. By improving tooling, platform reliability, deployment workflows, and observability, this role directly impacts the speed, quality, and stability of product delivery across experiences that serve millions of sports and entertainment fans worldwide.

Work Environment:

This role is designated as fully remote and is expected to be performed from a non-Versant worksite, typically an employee's residence. While primarily remote, occasional in-person collaboration opportunities, team meetings, and business gatherings may occur throughout the year.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead the design, implementation, and operation of reliable internal developer platforms and self-service infrastructure provisioning capabilities.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and automation across GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, and related technologies.
  • Apply Site Reliability Engineering principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and DORA metrics, to improve developer-facing systems and software delivery performance.
  • Drive adoption of engineering best practices, platform standards, and self-service capabilities across multiple engineering teams.
  • Develop and maintain golden paths, service templates, scaffolding tools, and standardized engineering workflows that accelerate software delivery and reduce operational complexity.
  • Improve local development environments, CLI tooling, environment provisioning, preview deployments, and ephemeral environments to enhance developer productivity.
  • Build observability solutions and dashboards that provide visibility into CI/CD health, deployment success, build performance, developer wait times, and platform reliability.
  • Partner with engineering teams to identify sources of operational toil and implement automation that improves efficiency, reliability, and developer experience.
  • Support cloud-native workloads and deployment patterns across containers, serverless technologies, and event-driven architectures.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues impacting developer workflows, including build failures, test instability, deployment issues, and environment drift.
  • Collaborate with Security and Platform Operations teams to embed secure-by-default controls and compliance guardrails into developer workflows.
  • Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance on platform architecture, automation strategies, observability, and cloud-native development practices.
  • Influence platform roadmaps and technical investments through data-driven recommendations and cross-functional collaboration.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Developer Experience, DevOps, or related engineering disciplines.
  • Experience building and supporting internal developer platforms, self-service infrastructure, or developer tooling.
  • Strong hands-on experience with CI/CD technologies, including GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with AWS cloud services and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Go, Bash, TypeScript, or similar languages.
  • Experience working with containerized environments and orchestration technologies including Docker, ECS, and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with observability practices and tools, including Datadog and application performance monitoring solutions.
  • Experience leading technical initiatives that span multiple teams or product domains.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to create clear technical documentation, guides, and operational runbooks.
  • Experience supporting modern application frameworks and cloud-native architectures.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation supporting production systems and developer platforms.

Bonus Points:

  • AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer.
  • Experience supporting high-scale consumer-facing digital platforms.
  • Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
  • Experience with developer portals, service catalogs, or internal platform products.

How We Do It at Versant:

  • Trust by building reliable systems, following through on commitments, and prioritizing operational excellence.
